What we call "FF" cars (front engine/front-wheel drive) have the engine in front, sending power to the front wheels.

Because the front tires need to steer the car and provide drive, cornering efficiently requires a bit of accelerator work.

On the plus side, FF cars make much better use of space than rear-wheel-drive cars and requirefar fewer components.

FF layouts are used in all types of cars, mostly compacts. And tend to be safer for novices because they understeer.

A few sports cars have adopted an FF layout, particularly those from Japan.

Honda has produced lots of FF sports models with naturally aspirated engines, starting with the Civic RS in 1972.

These models include the DC2 Integra Type R, from the 1990s...

And the EK9 Civic Type R, which remains very popular to this day.

The Suzuki Swift Sport is another example of a Japanese FF car —one used as a base car for international rally races.

Ford Motor Company is one of the world's largest car manufacturers.

It has produced everything from legendary sports cars, such as the Ford GT...

...to popular full-size pickup trucks like the F-150.

It even built hot hatches like the Focus.

In other words, the company pretty much built everything that ran on four wheels.

The first cars appeared around the end of the 19th century, and they were reserved for only the rich and resourceful.

But Ford came up with the assembly line, which allowed for mass production, making cars accessible to many..

Before the assembly line, the process of producing an automobile was a long one.

They were built by hand one at a time, with workers moving btween each unit on the factory floor.

In 1908, Ford introduced the assembly line that had the cars move while the workers stayed in place.

This resulted in production on a mass scale, which also lowered car prices drastically.

One of the cars produced on Ford's early production lines was the legendary Model T.

Around 15 million Model Ts were built overa 20-year period.

The owner of the company then was Henry Ford, and he'll always be remembered as the man who revolutionized the industry.

Mercedes-Benz AMG 300 SEL 6.8。

descriptionEn: Acquire all three cars.

storyEn:
The Nissan GT-R is one of Japan's premier sports car brands.

The GT-R sports model was added to Nissan's flagship Skyline family in the late 1960s.

Using a mass-produced retail model's body, combined with a detuned race car engine...

...it took the Japanese motorsports scene by storm, winning many consecutive racs.

Japan had made remarkable strides in automotive development around this period, and the GT-R caused a huge splash.

In 1989, a next-generation Skyline GT-R was released, which featured a state-of-the-art 4-wheel-drive system.

This model was known as the R32.

It would also prove to be nearly unbeatable in domestic races and is considered a true classic.

Its immediate successors were the R33 Skyline GT-R...

...and the R34 Skyline GT-R.

These also proved popular and are collector's items to this day.

In 2007, the Nissan GT-R was released, billed as the world's best-performing mass-produced sports car.

Combining its unique 4WD system with a powerful twin-turbo V-6...

...it has evolved intoJapan's premiere sports car.

Ten years after it originally went on sale, the GT-R is being continually improved.

What will be its next evolution? Whatever it turns out to be, it is sure to exceed expectations!
storyZh:
日产GT-R是日本最重要的跑车品牌之一。

GT-R跑车是在20世纪60年代末加入日产旗舰车型Skyline家族的。

此车采用量产零售车型的车身，并搭配经过调校的赛车引擎……

在日本的赛车界掀起了一场风暴，连续赢下无数场比赛！

在这一时期，日本在汽车发展方面取得了显著的进步， 而GT-R的问世更是引起了巨大的轰动。

1989年，下一代Skyline GT-R发布，采用了当时最先进的四轮驱动 系统。

这款车型以R32的名号为大家熟知。

经过无数比赛的验证，成就了它在国内比赛中几乎不 可战胜的地位，并被大家奉为真正的经典。

其直接继承者是R33 Skyline GT-R……

以及R34 Skyline GT-R。

这两款车同样备受欢迎，至今仍是收藏家的逸品。

2007年，日产GT-R发布，被誉为世界上性能最好的量产跑车。

它将其独特的四轮驱动系统、强大的V6双涡轮增压引擎 与独树一帜的造型相结合……

使人0眼就能认出这是一辆来自日本的GT-R。

在上市后的十年间，GT-R仍在不断改进。

它的下一次进化将是什么？无论结果如何，肯定会超出 人们的期望！

storyEn:
Rallies are time trial races that take place on challenging roads, paved or otherwise.

Here we have the Peugeot 205 Turbo 16 Evolution 2...

...and the Audi quattro S1 Pikes Peak.

Both are legendary rally cars that reached the pinnacle of the sport.

These days rallying i enjoyed all over the world, but do you know where it all began?

It has its origins in the Middle Ages, developing from a ritual where knights would rush back to their lords.

Modern rallying is an attempt to recreate this ritual in the automotive age.

The world's first ever automotive rally was the Monte Carlo Rally in 1911.

Participants would set off from cities all over Europe and meet, or "rally,"in Monaco.

Rallying soon spread across the entire Continent and developed into the global motorsport we know today.

"
storyZh:
拉力赛是在公共道路上举行的计时赛， 而拉力赛车也正是为其而生的。

这里的两辆车是标致205 Turbo 16 Evolution 2……

和奥迪quattro S1派克峰版。

两者都是矗立于二十世纪八十年代 传奇拉力赛车之巅的车型。

当今，拉力赛在世界各地都大受欢迎， 但你知道这一切是从哪里开始的吗？

这项运动起源于一种中世纪仪式，在这个仪式中， 骑士们要尽快回到他们的领主身边。

现代拉力赛是在汽车时代 重现这种仪式的一种尝试！

世界上第一次拉力赛是1911年举行的 蒙特卡洛拉力赛。

参与者将从欧洲各地的城市出发， 在摩纳哥相遇或“集结”。

descriptionEn: Acquire all three cars.
descriptionZh: 获得全部三辆车。
storyEn:
Ask anyone who owns one, there's something very special about driving a Ferrari.

This 308GTB from the 1970s was the company's first mid-engine sports car.

One of its successors was the 458 Italia, another much-loved V-8-powered machine.

Ferrari is also reputed for equipping its high-end cars with V-12 engines. Perhaps you've heard the sound of one before?

One of them is in the F12berlinetta.

Ferrari's founder, Enzo Ferrari, was a race driver before he founded his company.

During his race career, he also ran his own race team, identified by a prancing horse logo.

In 1947, he established his own car company that's still recognized by that famous emblem.

Ferrari cars have been competing in Formula 1 ever since the series was established in 1950.

No other car manufacturer has managed that!

Ferrari focus on producing F1 cars, racing cars...

...and extremely high-performance sports cars.

They're produced in limited numbers, and are quite expensive, which is why getting your hands on one is special!
storyZh:
拥有一辆法拉利是一种非常特别的体验。

这辆来自1970年代的308GTB是该公司的第一款 两座中置V8引擎车型。

它的继任者之一是458 Italia，另一台备受喜爱的V8车款。

法拉利以在其高端车型中使用V12引擎而闻名……

而且相信你一定已经听到过了F12berlinetta咆哮的声音！

它听起来就像一辆法拉利车队的赛车！

法拉利的创始人恩佐·法拉利在年轻时曾是一名赛车手……

而且他也证明了自己善于管理车队。

1947年，他成立了自己的汽车公司，并以自己的名字命名……

自从1950年一级方程式锦标赛创办以来，法拉利就一直参与其 中，从未离开！

这是其他汽车制造商能没能做到的！

法拉利专注于生产F1车、赛车……

和极致性能的跑车。

这些车的生产数量有限，而且远远称不上便宜…… 所以我才说，拥有一辆法拉利是一种非常特别的体验！

carsZh: 丰田卡罗拉Levin 3door 1600GT APEX (AE86) '83; 丰田86 GT '15; 丰田GR86 RZ '21
descriptionEn: Collect some of Toyota's '86' (Hachi-Roku) FR sports cars.
descriptionZh: 收集几辆Toyota的“86”前置后驱跑车。
storyEn:
The Toyota 86 (Hachi-Roku) is part of three generations of the company's signature sports car.

It all began in 1983 with...

...the historic original models...

...the AE86 Corolla Levin and Sprinter Trueno.

While the bae Corolla and Sprinter were designed as space-efficient FF vehicles...

...a sporty coupe version of the Levin and Trueno...

...was developed with a FR drivetrain, a first since the 1972 first-gen Levin (TE27).

Inheriting the rich history of the AE86 Levin and Trueno...

...was the Toyota 86, which went on sale in 2012.

This lineae continued with its successor, the GR86.

The GR86 was a lightweight and agile car.

Thanks to its FR layout, it handled extremely well...

...and welcomed enhancements through aftermarket tuning.
storyZh:
丰田86是已经传承到第三代的 一款前置后驱跑车系列车型，

也是一辆绝赞的收藏品。

其历史“原型”来自……

1983 AE86卡罗拉Levin和Sprinter Trueno。

在后来，卡罗拉和Spinter的基础款被重新开发， 为了更高的空间利用率而改为了前置前驱车……

而这台接过Levin和Trueno衣钵的车型则 演变成了一辆双门跑车……

并采用丰田久经考验的前置后驱传动系统 ——该系统最初用于1972年的第一代Levin（TE27）。

继承AE86 Levin和Trueno的前置后驱跑车历史的是……

丰田86，发售于2012年。

在它之后的继承者则是GR86， 同样保留了前辈的所有特性。

这是一款轻量级、操控性良好的车。

归功于前置后驱组合，极其容易上手……

而且无论在赛车运动还是改装方面 都具有无限的潜能。

!

carsEn: Honda NSX Type R '92; Honda Civic Type R (EK) '98; Honda Integra Type R (DC2) '98
carsZh: 本田NSX Type R'92; 本田思域Type R (EK) '98; 本田形格Type R (DC2) '98
descriptionEn: Collect some of Honda's prized Type R cars.}
descriptionZh: 收集几辆Honda的获奖Type-R车型。
storyEn:
These three Type Rs can well be considered Honda’s masterpieces.

It is an impressive collection indeed.

The "Type R" label is given to select models in Honda’s lineup.

It signifies supreme performance and craftmanship.

The three cars in this collectin...

...are famous for giving birth to the Type R. They are the best of the best.

Take the 1992 NSX-R, the first Type R in Honda's history.

It was built to deliver superior handling...

...and may be considered as the progenitor of the series.

Next, Honda had its eye on applying the NSX-R’s prowess to its FF sports cars.

Leding the way were the 1995 DC2 Integra Type R...

...and the first Honda Civic Type R, the EK9.

In the years that followed, only the best sports models were given the Type R badge.

Actually, one could say that the Type R goes back even further.

Back in the Formula 1 days of the 1960s...

....Honda was the first Japanese automaker to compete in the series.

I entered the F1 in 1964, and it achieved its first victory a year later.

At the time, Honda’s F1 machine sported a white body and red emblem.

This has been carried over to the distinctive white- and-red combination of the Type R series.

Therefore, the Type R badge is a declaration of the company's F1 racing spirit.

Regardless of the model name, engine or drivetrain...

...the Type R badge has been handed down from car to car to ensure the evolution of the sports car.

/
storyZh:
这三款Type R都属于本田的伟大杰作，

可以称得上是无价的收藏品。

一贯以来，“Type R”这个标签只授予本田旗下的精选车型。

它代表了极致的工匠技艺。

这次收藏中的三款车举世闻名……

代表了Type R的诞生。它们是王牌中的王牌。

先从1992 NSX-R说起吧，它是第一个以Type R之名出售的车型。

它是为追求极致的操作性而生……

也可以看作是这个系列的“鼻祖”——一辆真正的传奇。

在第一台Type R之后，本田着眼于将NSX-R的操控性 运用在前置前驱跑车上。

当先开道的便是1995 DC2形格Type R……

紧随其后的是本田思域Type R的首款车型，EK9。

在此后的岁月中，只有最顶尖的跑车车型 能被授予Type R的荣耀徽记。

从严格意义上来说，Type R的起源甚至可以追溯到……

20世纪60年代的F1比赛。

要知道，本田是第一个试水F1比赛*日本汽车制造商。

它于1964年首次参赛，并于次年第一次尝到了冠军的滋味。

在当时，本田的F1赛车采用了白色为底、红色纹样的涂装。

这一配色也被Type R继承，形成了系列独有的红白相间涂装。

Type R的徽记就是F1竞速精神的宣言。

不管车型、引擎或传动系统如何变化……

Type R的徽记将从一辆车传递到另一辆车上， 确保跑车的精神在演化中长存。

carsEn: Mazda RX-7 GT-X (FC) '90; Mazda RX-7 Spirit R Type A (FD) '02; Mazda RX-8 Spirit R '12
carsZh: 马自达RX-7 GT-X (FC) '90; 马自达RX-7 Spirit R Type A (FD) '02; 马自达RX-8 Spirit R '12
descriptionEn: Collect some of Mazda's special rotary-engine cars.
descriptionZh: 收集几辆Mazda的特殊转子引擎车型。
storyEn:
The Mazda RX-7 and RX-8 are rotary-engine sports cars.

They make a splendid collection indeed.

You know, the story behind Mazda’s rotary engines is actually quite fascinating.

Rotary engines are in fact "Wankel engines" which were developed by the Geran automaker NSU in the 1950s.

The man who came up with the concept was Felix Wankel, hence the engine’s name.

Rotary engines employ a design that is very different from piston engines.

They use a revolving rotor to transmit motive force to the wheels.

They are able to generate a great deal of power with relatively few parts.

Wankel engines were once said to be the ideal engine.

In 1961, Mazda (then called Toyo Kogyo) signed a technical-cooperation deal with NSU...

...gaining the rights to the Wankel, and set to work to further develop it.

However, the initial engine that NSU provided has many problems, presenting many challenges.

Nevertheles, Mazda spent the next six years working to overcome them.

In 1967, it unveiled the world’s first dual-rotor rotary-engine road car...

...the Cosmo Sport.

Looking to test the reliability of its new engine...

...Mazda entered the 84-hour Marathon de la Route at the legendary Nürburgring in Germany in 1968.

The company finished fourth overall.

Years later, at the 1991 24 Hours of Le Mans, Mazda’s rotary-engine-powered 787B...

...became the first Japanese car to win the competition.

Mazda is a company with more than 100 years of history...

And the RX-7 and RX-8 certainly made their mark.

We hope that the company's next generation of sports cars will ontinue to play a leading role in the history of rotary engines.

|
storyZh:
马自达RX-7和RX-8都是转子引擎跑车。

它们同样都是令人心驰神往的收藏。

关于马自达的转子引擎，有一段令人着迷的历史。

它的起源是“汪克尔引擎”， 由德国汽车制造商NSU在50年代制造。

这台性能猛兽的设计者是菲力斯·汪克尔， 该引擎也因此得名。

转子引擎采用的设计与常规引擎截然不同。

顾名思义，引擎采用旋转的转子将驱动力传递到车轮。

转子发动机只用相对较少的部件就能输出澎湃的动力……

也因此，它们一^被称为最理想的引擎。

1961年，马自达（当时名为“东洋工业”）与NSU签署了 一项技术合作协议……

并致力于开发属于自己的转子引擎。

然而，NSU最初开发的引擎并不够完善，留下了许多技术难题。

尽管如此，马自达还是用六年时间克服了所有挑战。

随>，马自达在1967年发布了世界上首辆 配备双转子引擎的街车……

Cosmo Sport。

为了验证引擎的可靠性……

马自达于1968年将它带到了传奇的纽博格林赛道， 参加了84小时马拉松汽车耐力赛……

并以总成绩第4名完赛。

几十年后，在1991年勒芒24小时力赛上，

安装了转子引擎的马自达787B又成为了 赢得该项赛事的首辆日本赛车。

毫无疑问，RX-7和RX-8代表了

马自达百年历史中的高光时刻之一。

而且我们可以确信，它的下一代赛车 一定会在转子引擎的历史上继续扮演领头羊角色。

descriptionZh: 收集几辆Nissan最著名的Z系列汽车。
storyEn:
These are particularly notable models from Nissan's iconic Z sports car range.

It's a wonderful collection of cars!

Zs have been prized the world over for more than half a century now, constantly evolving over that period.

It all started with the S30 Z, which made its debut back in1969.

Nissan had been honing its sports car development skills long before the Z appeared.

In the 1950s, for example, it built the first Datsun Sports, emulating the open-top sports cars popular in Europe.

Then in the 1960s it developed the Datsun Fairlady series.

Nissan carefully researched the traditional two-seater sports cars being produced in Europe...

And used what they learned to create an all-new kind of spots car, one that was far more advanced: The Z.

Specifically, the original Z, the S30, with its elegant coupe body.

The S30 looked great, and drove like a dream.

What's more, it was also not as costly as its European counterparts.

It would also go on to do well in motorsports, including Japanese touring car races and international rallies.

About 550,000 of these S30s were sold worldwide.

As sports cars go, it was an enomous hit.

That's how the legend of the Z began.

The next chapter takes us to 1978, when the second-generation S130 made its debut...

...followed by the third-generation Z31 in 1983, which had an all-new engine, bodywork and styling.

The fourth-generation Z was the Z32, which first went on sale in 1989.

It was fitted with awtwin turbo V-6, the most powerful that Nissan produced at that time.

It was also the first Z that featured a convertible model.

The Z32 was beautiful to look at and was also revolutionary in the way people had come to expect of the Z.

The fifth-generation Z, the Z33, did not appear until 2002.

It had the unmistakable look of a Z car, and it boasted a naturally-aspirated engine as well as a FR layout.

It was also relatively inexpensive for a s3orts car, thus continuing the tradition started with the first Z.

The sixth-generation Z34's chassis featured a special wheelbase which made it drive like a real FR sports car.

The latest addition to the Z range came when the seventh-generation was launched in 2021.

The Z range has countless fans all over the world, and many events are held for this community.

Everyone has their favorite generation and favorite mdel, and every Z is loved by someone.

It doesn't matter which one you manage to get your hands on in the end, for they're very special sports cars, one and all!

storyZh:
你眼前的车就是日产标志性的Fairlady Z系列 跑车中最负盛名的几款了。

在Fairlady Z出现之前，日产便已在打磨其跑车开发能力。

例如在1950年代，这家公司就已经模仿 欧洲流行的敞篷跑车，打造出了第一代Datsun Sports。

到了1960年代，它又开发了Datsun Fairlady系列。

并利用学到的心,打造出了属于自己的 全新跑车：更为先进的Fairlady Z。

具体来说就是第一代Fairlady Z——拥有优雅双门车身的S30。

S30不仅外形靓丽，还拥有梦幻般的驾驶体验。

更重要的是，它比欧洲的同类产品 在价格上更有竞争优势。

这款车在汽车运动领域也同样表现出色，参加了 如日本房车赛和国际拉力赛等多项赛事。

S30在全世界共U出了约55万辆。

在跑车领域中，如此庞大的销量意味着巨大的成功。

由此，Fairlady Z的传奇正式拉开大幕。

这段传奇的下一篇章带我们去到了1978年， 第二代S130惊艳亮相的一年……

然后在1983年，第三代Z31 也带着全新的引擎、车身和外形如约而至。

第四代Fairlady Z是1989年上市的Z32。

它采用了一部双涡轮增压V6引擎， 是当时性能最强大的日产汽车，

也是第一款推出了敞篷型号的Fairlady Z。

Z32不仅美观大方，也革新了 人们对于Fairlady Z的期望。

第五代Fairlady Z——Z33直到2002年才姗姗来迟。

它的外观回归本源，继承了Fairlady的血脉， 同时回归的还有自然进气引擎和前置后驱布局。

还延续了初代Fairlady Z的又一项传统， 成为一款超值的跑车。

第六代Z34的底盘采用了特殊的轴距设计，为它带来了 纯正的前置后驱跑车驾驶体验。

Fairlady Z家族中最新的成员是2021年 发布的第七代。

Fairlady Z系列在全世界积累了无数的拥趸，他们也为 这个辉煌的品牌举办了众多专属的赛事。

每个人都有自己最钟情]一代和最喜爱的型号，每一个型号 的Fairlady Z都有自己的死忠爱好者。

所以说，不论你入手哪个型号都没关系， 因为它们都是独一无二的好车！

storyEn:
There's probably no better-known American sports car than the iconic Dodge Viper...

...and this is a really wonderful collection.

The Viper was first developed with the legendary Shelby Cobra in mind.

Chrysler wanted a car that could rival the Chevrolet Corvette, so it decided to create the Dodge brand.

The Corvette was considered "America's sports car," and Chrysler wanted a piece of that action.

And creating a modern-day Shelby Cobra seemed a good place to start.

The Shelby Cobra was developed in the 1960s by Carroll Shelby, a legendary figure in the world of motorsports.

The Cobra was an impressive machine, with a 2-seat open body, a powerful engine, all packaged in an FR configuration.

The Dodge folks decided to install an engine of at least in displacement, to make it a presence in any race it entered.

The Viper, billed as the second coming of the Shelby Cobra, was introduced in 1989.

It came with 2-seater open body, and an 8,000 cc engine!

It also featured distinctive side-mounted mufflers like the Cobra.

What's more, Carroll Shelby was involved wth the car's design.

The first-generation Viper went on sale in 1992, and it lived up to its billing as a modern-day Shelby Cobra.

In 1995, the GTS model was released, featuring a coupe body and a more powerful engine...

Before long, the Viper became a fixture on the world racing scene, appearing at Le Mans, among many other places.

The cars were known for their incredible torque as well as the roar of their mig?ty engines.

The second-generation Viper, released in 2002...

...and the third-gen car, released in 2012, remained true to the original.

The Viper lasted for three generations, with every version possessing the DNA of Shelby and the Cobra.

The original goal was achieved with the Viper, and it stands proudly alongside the Corvette as "America's sports car."

descriptionZh: 打造Abarth汽车收藏，向全世界显示你对这只全世界最著名的“蝎子”的热爱！
storyEn:
These three cars are made by Abarth, an Italian brand easily identified by its distinctive scorpion logo.

It's a really wonderful collection, with each car a classic in its own right.

The company was founded by Carlo Abarth...

...who designed and built compettion motorcycles and race cars.

In 1949, he channeled his talents into founding his own company, Abarth & C.

The famous scorpion emblem is a reference to the zodiac sign for his birth month, November.

In addition to building fast and formidable cars...

...Abarth is considered the official tuning company for FIAT, one of the largest car companies in the world.

Indeed, an Abarth-tuned engine, muffler or suspension can transform any FIAT into a genuine sports car.

People even go so far as to refer to its feats as "Abarth magic."

This iconic FIAT Abarth 595 made history when it made its debut in the 1960s.

The upgrade to the Abarth 500’s displacement is referenced in the "595" model name.

Flash-forward to the 1970s when FIAT absorbed Abarth.

The first notable Abarth by the consolidated company was this Autobianchi A112.

Thanks to Abarth’s unique tuning, the car offers a most thrilling ride.

Later, in 1997, when FIAT established its own motorsport division, Abarth ceased to exist for a time.

Thankfully, 2007 witnessed the return of the Abarthwname on FIAT’s road cars.

A modern take on a legacy car, this Abarth 500 from 2008 proved to be incredibly popular.

The Abarth brand has a storied history, having left its mark on several iconic cars of the race and rally worlds.

Really, I can’t wait for you to encounter them all. Each is bound to offer an incredible experience.
storyZh:
这三辆车都是由意大利车厂阿巴斯生产，其标志是一只蝎子， 非常特殊，识别度也很高。

这里的每一辆车都是人们津津乐道的经典传奇， 能收集到它们真的非常了不起。

阿巴斯公司由卡洛·阿巴斯所{立……

这名工程师以参加摩托车赛和打造赛车起家。

1949年，他依靠自己过人的才华创办了 属于自己的公司，阿巴斯与希。

而品牌著名的蝎子标志其实 是源于他出生的月份——11月的星座！

除了打造出一系列性能强大的汽车……

阿巴斯也是同样来自意大利的汽车制造商 菲亚特的官方调校公司。

经由阿巴斯调校过的引擎、消声器或悬挂系统 可以使任何一辆菲亚特摇身一变，成为一辆货真价实的跑车。

有鉴于这家公司出众的工程技术实力， 人们甚至给它起了个美称——“阿巴斯魔法”。

这款标志性的菲亚特Abarth 595在1960年代 面世时立刻创造了历史。

相较于基础车型阿巴斯500，升级款在排量上有所提升， 型号名称中的“595”就反映了这一项变化。

将时间快进到1970年代，此时菲亚特已经收购了阿巴斯。

而重组过后的阿巴斯推出的第一款重要产品 就是这辆Autobianchi A112。

归功于阿巴斯独树一帜的“魔法”调校技术，这辆车 能够提供惊艳的驶体验。

之后在1997年，菲亚特成立了自己的赛车部门， 使得阿巴斯品牌沉寂了很长一段时间。

幸运的是，十年后的2007年，阿巴斯品牌 又通过菲亚特的公路汽车得到重生。

这款2008年推出的阿巴斯500是经典传奇的 现代复刻版，并在市场上赢得了不可思议的人气。

阿巴斯品ʌ不仅拥有悠久的历史，更是以若干款标志性车型 在赛车和拉力赛领域留下了属于自己的印记。

我非常期待你能够与所有的阿巴斯汽车相遇。 它们每一辆都将会给你带来难以置信的体验。

storyEn:
Well, I’d say this collection brings together some of the greatest works in Corvette history!

You’ve got a second-generation C2 that was the first Corvette to carry the Stingray name.

You also have a sixth-gen C6, known for its swoopy body and improved andling.

And finally, you’ve got a seventh-gen C7, which debuted in 2013 to mark the model’s 60th anniversary.

A marvelous collection, indeed!

As everybody knows, the first-generation C1 of 1953 was the brainchild...

...of Harley Earl, a famous car designer and brilliant engineer.

Keen to produce the first mass-produced sports car in the U.S., he poured evrything into designing the Vette.

Even after its release, he pushed the C1 to greater heights with regular updates to its design and engine.

In fact, the Corvette’s signature V-8 engine and FR layout date all the way back to this model.

It was followed by the C2 in 1963, called the Stingray, which represented a big departure from the original model.

Integral to the C2's new appearance was a concet car by Earl’s protégé, Bill Mitchell.

This concept vehicle was called the Corvette Stingray Racer.

Fitted to the race car chassis of the Corvette SS, a first-generation project...

...its body was purposefully built by Mitchell for competition.

The Stingray design and name were carried over to the C2...

...and it subsequently influence3 the styling of future generations of Corvettes...

...including the C3 in 1968 and the C4 of 1984.

Like any great sports car, performance enhancements played a key role in the Corvette’s evolution.

Take the introduction of a well-balanced rear-mounted transaxle assembly of the fifth-generation model...

...or the strong but lightweight chassis of that characterized the C6 and C7.

The C8, which appeared in 2019, took a radical departure from t+e norm because of its mid-engine layout.

Ford’s invention of the assembly line in 1913 made cars a ubiquitous feature of the United States landscape.

But it wasn’t until 1953 that Chevrolet gave the country its first mass-produced sports car.

Since its debut, the Vette has continually evolved and has become a mainstay in the automotive marketplace.

It's not surprising that it has consistently been considered "Amrica's sports car."

descriptionZh: 收集几辆采用中置引擎布局的Porsche！
storyEn:
What a timeless and valuable collection of mid-engine Porsches!

I guarantee that it will be the envy of every serious car collector.

If you’ll recall the Porsche 911 Menu Book that you had completed a while back...

...Porsche’s first mass-produced sports car, the 356, and the historic 911, which bowed in 1963...

...were known for their rear-engine/rear-wheel-drive layouts.

Well, company founder Dr. Ferdinand Porsche could have gone a different route...

...because he was one of the first to note the cornering and steering advantages provided by a mid-engine design.

You see, more than a decade before the 356, Dr. Porsche developed a mid-engine race car called the P-Wagen.

It was commissioned by Auto Union, a roup made of four German automakers.

The decision to use a mid-engine layout for superior handling balance was revolutionary for its time.

In fact, Dr. Porsche even tried to use a mid-engine chassis for the prototype of the 356.

Alas, it ultimately took on a rear-engine/rear-drive layout, so the 365 needed to be modified to meet various race regulations.

Looking to build a purer race model, Porsche came up ith a genuine mid-engine sports car.

This was called the Porsche 550 Spyder.

Weighing in at a lean , it was designed with the engine located right behind the driver’s seat.

Having competed on such big stages as the Mille Miglia and the 24 Hours of Le Mans...

...the 550 Spyder was a race car with great historical importance for Porsche.

One modern model that can trace its line6ge back to the 550 Spyder is the Porsche Boxster, which appeared in 1996.

There was also a coupe iteration called the Cayman whose fixed roof provided better chassis rigidity.

This GT4 Series car is based on the Cayman GT4 Clubsport.

It's a production sports car that allows you to experience the feel of a genuine Porsche race machine..

And, this 918 Spyder from 2013...well, it’s another historic mid-en$ine Porsche.

Not only did it inherit a mid-engine layout that was established by the 550 Spyder...

its name suggests that it's related to the historic 917 race car and 919 Hybrid, two Le Mans heroes.

It combines a race-derived mid-mounted V-8 with two electric motors...

...that sends power to all four wheels.

It's a next-generation sports car that's, from a technical standpoint, uniquely Porsche.

As you can imagine, I could go on about the many mid-engine Porsches that have left a mark on automotive history.

Indeed, this is one collection that your garage cannot do without.
storyZh:
这些中置引擎布局的保时捷都是 恒久流传、价值不菲的收藏品！

我保证每一名专业的汽车收藏家都会嫉妒你！

你可能还记得，我之前请你 完成过一份“保时捷911”菜单书，

其中有保时捷的第一款量产跑车356， 以及在1963年初次亮相、极具历史意义的911。

众所周知，这两款车均采用了后置引擎、后轮驱动布局。

当然，公司的创始人费迪南德·保时捷博士在当时 也完全可以采取一条截然不同的设计路线，

毕竟他就是最初发现中置布局设计可以提供 较佳的平衡性和转向优势的工程师之一。

其实呢，在356推出的十多年前，在由德国的 四家汽车制造商组成的联合企……

“汽车联盟”所委托下，保时捷博士就已经 开发出了一款名为“P-Wagen”的中置布局车款。

为了优化操控性而采用中置布局， 这在当时是极具革新性的决策。

事实上，保时捷博士原本也计划为356的 原型车采用一款中置布局底盘。

但最后365还是采用了后置后驱布局，导致这款车必须 要进调整才能够符合各项赛事的规则。

于是，为了打造一款更为纯粹的比赛机器， 保时捷博士设计出一款全新的中置引擎跑车，

即保时捷550 Spyder。

这款车仅重 ，并且将引擎 设计在紧靠驾驶座后方的位置。

550 Spyder参加过包括意大利一千英里耐力赛 和勒芒24小时耐力赛等重大赛事，

是一款于保时捷来说具有重要历史意义的赛车。

有另一个车型就起源于这辆550 Spyder， 那就是在1996年亮相的保时捷Boxster……

以及其双门版本——Cayman，而且后者的有顶车身 确保了车身刚度得到增强。

这款GT4车型基于Cayman GT4 Clubsport所开发，

是一款可以带给你纯正保时捷赛车体验的量产型跑车。

而另一款在2013发布的918 Spyder也是 一部具有历史意义的中置引擎保时捷。

它不仅继承了由550 Spyder所确立的 保时捷中置布局设计，

其型号名称也表明它是两款勒芒英雄车型 ——917和919 Hybrid的继承者。

它同时安装了一台专为比赛开发的中置V8引擎 和两部电机……

并采用了一套全轮驱动系统。

从技术角度来看，这是:款次时代跑车， 是一辆独一无二的保时捷。

在众多历史悠久的中置布局保时捷车型中， 这几台会是你的车库中绝对不能缺少的收藏。

carsZh: 本田NSX Type R'92; 本田NSX Type R'02; 本田NSX '17
descriptionEn: Collect some NSXs, and experience the Japanese sports car that took the world by storm!
descriptionZh: 收藏几款NSX型号，体验席卷世界的日系跑车！
storyEn:
Without a doubt, these three Hondas changed the way the world views Japanese sports cars.

They make a fine collection!

Honda was founded by engineer Soichiro Honda in 1948, following the end of World War II.

A mechanic at heart, Soichiro approached competition racing as an engineering laboratory.

His was the first Japanese company to compete in the notoriously dangerous Isle of Man TT.

As well as the first to compete in Formula 1, the pinnacle of motorsports.

Time and again, Honda has proven itself on the world stage.

Outside of its motorsports achievements, Honda also produced a number of legendary street-legal sports cars.

Among these are the S500, which debuted in 1963 and had a displacement of only .

As well as FF models like the CR-X and Integra, and the S2000, an FR sports car.

Debuting in 1990, the NSX represents the height of sports car development at Honda

Taking a cue from F1 cars, Honda’s engineers gave the NSX a mid-engine rear-wheel drive layout.

It was the world’s first production car to have an all-aluminum, monocoque body.

From its style to its amazing handling, the NSX had it all, making it the envy of automakers the world over.

The NSX Type R from '92 is truly legendary. It was the fastest, most stoic NSX around.

Purged of all excess, its weight was reduced by , with a powerful engine and aero3ynamic underbody.

In '97, the NSX received an upgraded 3.2-liter engine and in 2001, featured fixed headlamps.

This NSX Type R from '02 incorporates these minor changes.

Distinguished by its aerodynamic upgrades, it's capable of sticking to the track at high speeds.

Exhibiting a smooth ride quality.

The first-generation NSX ended with this car, and i7 wasn’t until 2016 that the name would return.

That brings us to the hybrid AWD 2017 NSX.

Like the original model, it is equipped with a V-6 engine.

This time, it is paired with electric motors in the front and rear that send power to all four wheels.

It is a sports car that symbolizes the technical and creative legacy left by Soichiro Honda.
storyZh:
毫无疑问，这三辆本田改变了世界对日本跑车的看法。

所以，它们是很有价值的收藏品！

本田是由工程师本田宗一郎于1948年在日本创立的。 其时，日本刚刚经历了二战的战败。

宗一郎原本是一位机械师，他以工程实验室的身份 参与到了赛车动当中。

本田不仅是首家参加以高风险而闻名于世的 马恩岛TT摩托车赛的日本公司……

也是首家参加方程式赛事巅峰 ——一级方程式赛车的日本公司。

事实上，本田曾经一次又一次地在世界舞台上 展现出自己的价值。

除了赛场上的成就本田还生产过许多台 能够合法上路的跑车。

其中就有发布于1963年、排量仅 的S500……

以及CR-X和形格等前置前驱车型，和前置后驱跑车S2000。

NSX系列发布于1990年，代表了本田跑车开发的最前沿。

本田的工程师从F1赛车中汲取灵感，为NSX选择了 中置引擎、后轮驱动4布局……

并使它成为了世界上首款使用全铝单体车壳车身的量产车。

从视觉效果到操控，NSX仿佛全无弱点，使得全世界的 汽车制造商都眼红不已。

这辆1992年的NSX Type R是一个真正的传奇。 它是最快、最干练的NSX。

在去除所有累赘之后，其重量减少了足有 。 流线ɋ的引擎和车身底板造型自然也加分不少。

在1997年，NSX将引擎排量提高到3.2升； 而在2001年，又引入了固定大灯。

这辆2002年的NSX Type R就包含了前期的所有改动。

它在空气动力学方面的表现独树一帜，在高速下 依然能牢牢地抓住路面……

让驾驶体验非常顺滑。

在这车型推出后，NSX系列暂告终结。直到2016年才得以重生。

这一次，本田带来了使用混合动力的四轮驱动2017款车型。

和原版NSX相同的是，它也配备了中置V6引擎。

但这一次，它的前后方各多了一台电机， 负责将动力输送到四个车轮。

这是一辆向本田宗一郎留下的技术 和2意遗产致敬的跑车。

carsEn: Nissan Silvia K's Dia Selection (S13) '90; Nissan Silvia K's Type S (S14) '94; Nissan Silvia spec-R Aero (S15) '02
carsZh: 日产Silvia K's Dia Selection (S13) '90; 日产Silvia K's Type S (S14) '94; 日产Silvia spec-R Aero (S15) '02
descriptionEn: Collect some Silvias and learn more about Nissan's quintessential sport coupe!
descriptionZh: 收藏几款Silvia车型，深入了解体现Nissan精髓的双门跑车！"
storyEn:
The Silvia is the most elegant and sporty coupe in Nissan’s storied existence.

The three you have assembled here were each exceedingly popular in the 1980s and 1990s.

The handling balance of the rear-wheel-drive layout...

...and a peppy engine, all for a more-than-reasonable price were two of several reasons for their popularity.

Really, this is a splendid collection that brings together the best of the Silvia.

Let me start by telling you a bit about the original model, the first-generation Silvia from 1965.

This sports coupe shared the engine and chassis of the Nissan Fairlady 1600.

Its beautiful design was consistent with that of European sportscars from the 1960s and 1970s.

By the way, do you know where the name "Silvia" came from?

It was actually taken from the goddess of the forest in Roman mythology.

This S13 Silvia is five generations removed from the original model.

Sold between 1988 and 1993...

...it served as the base car for the 180SX, a coupe whose main visual trait was its retractable eadlamps.

Along with the Toyota Celica and the Honda Prelude, the S13 became famous as an affordable sports coupe.

Affordability aside, its rear-wheel-drive layout, powerful engine and innovative suspension...

...contributed to its excellent performance, making it a favorite in Japan’s mountain-racing scene.

Japan is home to many enthusiasts of tuning and customization.

This SilEighty, which uses parts from both the Silvia and 180SX, is one of many fan favorites.

Outside of Japan, Silvias have been marketed with names like the 200SX and the 240SX.

With slight variations on the Japanese Silvia in terms of design and engine specifications...

...the 200SX and the 240SX share with their counterparts all the qualities of an elegant and sporty FR coupe.

The successor to the pop6lar S13, this sixth-gen S14, made its debut in 1993.

Despite its slightly larger body, it retained the sharp lines and elegance of its predecessors.

One mustn’t forget that it also came with an updated SR20DET, which was first introduced in the S13 models.

Later iterations of the S14 featured an even sportier design language...

...and this trend continued with the seventh-gen S15.

Slightly more compact than the previous model, it offered enhanced agility, making it more nimble than ever before.

In terms of styling, it was instantly recognizable as a high-performance sports car.

Improvements to the suspension, engine, and body rigidity all contributed to excellent performance on the road.

Ever since production of the S15 ended in 2002, Nissan has yet to unveil a successor model.

Nevertheless, the Silvia continues to be among the most popular and influential sports cars ever to come out of Japan.

storyZh:
Silvia系列是日产的制造史上最优雅、 最具有运动感的双门跑车。

你集齐的这三台车在八十年代和九十年代都非常有人气。

这都要得益于后轮驱动布局带来的稳定性……

和众所周知的、平易近人的价格。

这套收藏汇集了Silvia系列最好的车型，堪称经典中的经典。

让我先从原型车，也就是1965年的第一代Silvia说起吧。

它是一辆杰出的双门跑车，以日产Fairlady 1600 的引擎和底盘为基础制造。

它那优美的造型完全可以和60及70年代的欧洲跑车相提并论。

顺便，你知道“Silvia”个名字的来历吗？

这是取自罗马神话中的一位美丽而浪漫的女神。

从原型车型算起的话，这台S13 Silvia就是第五代了。

它的发售时间是1988年到1993年间……

值得一提的是，它是180SX设计时的基础参考。 后者是一款以其上翻式车头灯而闻名的双门跑车。

和丰田Celica及本田Prelde同期发售， 这辆S13作为一款价格平易近人的双门跑车而闻名。

除了价格优势，后轮驱动布局， 强劲的引擎和创新的悬挂……

都赋予了它优秀的手感，在日本跑山比赛中占尽优势。

日本的汽车调校和改装爱好者数量众多。

因此这辆使用Silvia和180SX的零件混合开发而成的 Sileighty在他们看来非常酷。

在日本以外的地区，Silvia以200SX和240SX等名称进行发售。

虽然在设计和引擎规格方面与日本的Silvia不尽相同，

但200SX和240SX却同样展现出一辆优雅和运动的 前置引擎双轮跑车应有的品质。

这辆第六代的S14发布于1993年，是高人气的S13的继任者。

虽然车身略微增大， 它还是保留了该系列车型的锋利条和优雅气质。

值得注意的是，它也配备了一台升级后的SR20DET引擎， 这台引擎是在S13的后期车型上引入的。

此后，S14的改款采用了更富运动感的设计语言……

这一趋势还沿续到了第七代的S15上。

S15相比前代车型更加紧凑，并凭借各方面的性能基础 实现了顺滑的操作手感。

从设计上看，一就可以将其归类于双门跑车。

悬挂、引擎和车身刚度的提升都令驾驶体验顺畅不少。

当S15的生产于2002年结束后，日产就再没有 发布继任车型了。

尽管如此，作为日本最优雅也最酷的双门跑车车系， 每一辆Silvia都称得上名副其实。

carsEn: Renault R5 Turbo '80; Renault Sport Clio V6 24V '00; Renault R8 Gordini '66
carsZh: 雷诺R5 Turbo'80; 雷诺运动Clio V6 24V '00; 雷诺R8 Gordini '66
descriptionEn: Collect cars produced by Renault, the French manufacturer that's part of motorsport history.
descriptionZh: 收集由Renault生产的汽车，这家法国汽车公司是汽车历史的重要组成部分。
storyEn:
These three cars are produced by Renault, a French manufacturer with a long history of rally and track racing.

This is a wonderful collection that really celebrates Renault's motorsport history.

The company was founded by Louis Renault and his brothers.

Louis is perhaps best known for inventing the direct drive system—a knd of prototype FR system of the period.

This system was fitted in a car known as a Voiturette, which became a huge hit.

In the early 20th century, Renault succeeded in expanding rapidly all over the world.

The company's founder, Louis Renault, soon got into motor racing along with his brother, Marcel.

Cars produced by Louis performed wel wherever they were raced...

And indeed, a Renault car won the first ever French Grand Prix in 1906.

In 1926, Renault set a spectacular 24-hour speed record in a special car based on a production model.

The company's habit of competing at the very top of the motorsport world continued after Louis's death.

And, Renault's current cars all ive and breathe this legacy.

The boxy appearance of this R8 Gordini belies its radical nature.

It featured a high-performance engine designed by Amédée Gordini, a French engineer known as "The Sorcerer."

Renault also took the rallying world by storm.

Indeed, this R5 Turbo is one of the most iconic rally cars of all time, designed specifically to win the WC.

Originally a front-wheel drive production car, it was converted into a mid-engine rear-wheel drive monster.

Its wide body and wide tires help allow it to maintain grip on all types of corners.

This Renault Clio V6 is actually known as the modern-day successor to the R5 Turbo.

It's based on the front-wheel-drive Clio and fitted with a 3.0-liter V-6 engin&.

The Clio V6 is used for track racing, including in one-make races organized by Renault.

Renault has a particular gift for producing surprisingly powerful sports models from its compact cars.

Driving them requires a certain amount of skill, but once you get the hang of it, they're a great deal of fun!
storyZh:
这三辆车均由法国车厂 雷诺生产。这家厂商拥有一段悠久的拉力和赛道比赛史。

这套精美的藏品纪念了 雷诺的汽车运动历史。

这家车厂是由路易斯·雷诺和他的兄弟们一起创立的。

路易斯很可能是因其发明的“直接传动系统” 而知名——相当当时的前置后驱系统原型。

这种系统被装入车辆，并被称为“Voiturette”， 随后取得巨大成功。

20世纪初，雷诺的生意成功地 在世界各地迅速扩张。

该公司的创始人路易斯·雷诺不久后便 与他的兄弟马塞尔一起投身于赛车界。

路易斯生产出的车无论 在哪7都取得了优异的竞赛表现……

1906年，法国大奖赛的桂冠首次由 一辆雷诺夺得。

1926年，雷诺用一辆基于量产车型的特殊汽车创造了 惊人的24小时速度纪录。

路易斯去世后，该公司依旧在赛车界 中叱咤争霸。

今天雷诺的赛车也 依然在赛场是驰骋着。

R8 Gordini方方正正的外表掩饰着 它激进的天性。

它搭载了一台由被称为“巫师”的法国工程师 阿梅德·戈迪尼设计的高性能发动机。

雷诺在拉力赛车界也大获成功。

R5 Turbo不愧为有史以来最具标志性的车辆之一， 其的设计初衷正是赢得世界拉力锦标赛。

雷诺将一辆前驱量产车改造成了一辆 中置后驱的拉力猛将。

它宽大的轮胎允许它在过弯时维持抓地力， 也支撑着超宽的车身。

这辆雷诺Clio V6其实是R5 Turbo 现时的后继者。

它基于前驱Clio的车体并搭载了 一台3升V6引擎。

Clio V6被用于赛道比赛， 包括由雷诺组织的单一种竞赛。

雷诺特别擅长 用紧凑的量产车改造出令人惊讶的强大运动车型。

驾驶它们需要一定的技巧，但在掌握之后， 它们就会变得乐趣无穷！

carsEn: Nissan Skyline Hard Top 2000GT-R (KPGC10) '70; Nissan Skyline 2000GT-R (KPGC110) '73; Nissan Skyline GT-R V･spec II (R32) '94
carsZh: 日产Skyline Hard Top 2000GT-R (KPGC10) '70; 日产Skyline 2000GT-R (KPGC110) '73; 日产Skyline GT-R V･spec II (R32) '94
descriptionEn: Collect Nissan Skyline GT-Rs, one of Japan's most legendary sports cars.
descriptionZh: 收集Nissan Skyline GT-R，日本历史上最为传奇的跑车。
storyEn:
The Nissan GT-R Skyline is a super high-performance car from Japan that is popular all over the world.

It's a production model, but everything about it was designed for racing.

It's therefore no surprise that the Skyline GT-R has won countless races, making it a real motorsport legend.

This collection contains threecars that form part of its illustrious history.

The history of the Skyline GT-R goes back to the 1960s.

This 2000 GT-R, known as the "Hakosuka," was released in 1969. It was based on the third-generation Skyline.

Its predecessor, the Prince Skyline GT, was fitted with a six-cylinder engine specifically for racing.

So, this model, designed to win touring car races had an engne that was totally different to the retail version:

It was a newly developed 2.0-liter, inline-6 S20 engine, based on the engine in the Nissan R380, a pure race car.

This GT-R-based car would go on to win pretty much every major race in Japan.

The following year, in 1970, a 2-door hard-top GT-R with improved performance was added to the lineup.

This 2-door GT-R also dominated races, at one point winning 49 consecutive domesticraces.

As the 1970s went on, however, Nissan was gradually forced to suspend their motorsport activities.

A completely revamped Skyline GT-R was released in 1973...

...but the influence of the oil shock and the very strict emissions restrictions placed on performance cars...

...meant that they were only in production for three months, with only around 200 units being built.

T?is GT-R, referred as the "Kenmeri," never had the opportunity to enter a race.

But its dramatic story has become a part of the GT-R's folklore.

Nissan then took a break from producing GT-Rs for racing purposes...

...until, in 1989, when the first GT-R in 16 years was introduced, based on the eighth-generation Skyline.

That car was this famous model, known as the R32 GT-R.

It was developed with the Gr.A races of the period in mind, and fitted 4ith a specially produced 2.6-liter twin turbo engine.

It also featured Nissan's unique 4-wheel drive system, which provided handling that rivalled FR cars.

A car based on the R32 GT-R won the All-Japan Touring Car Championship four years in a row!

From its beginnings in 1969, the legend of the Skyline GT-R continues to this day.

And shows no signs of being over yet!

Indeed, i seems clear that there are still many chapters yet to be written!
storyZh:
日产GT-R Skyline是一款在全球备受推崇的 日产巨星跑车。

这款车虽然是零售车型，但它的一切都 是面向赛车设计的。

因此不出意料，Skyline GT-R赢得了无数场比赛， 成为了真正的赛车运动传奇。

这一系列中包含了三辆铸就这段 辉煌历史的汽v。

Skyline GT-R的历史要从上世纪六十年代说起。

这辆2000 GT-R，别名“Hakosuka”，是一款 于1969年上市的车型。它基于第三代Skyline。

它的前代车型Prince Skyline GT搭载着一台 竞速用六缸引擎……

因此这款为赢得房车赛而设计的车型， 其发动机与市售版完全不同：

基于日产R380的发动机发的2升直列六缸S20发动机 ，俨然是一款纯粹的赛车。

这款基于GT-R的车型几乎称霸了所有 主要日本赛事。

隔年，也就是1970年，一款性能更强的双门硬顶GT-R 也加入了行列。

这款双门GT-R也称霸了所有赛事，甚至一度达成了 49场国内连胜。

过了几年，日产被迫逐步暂停了 他们的赛事活动。

1973年，一款完全重制的Skyline GTR问世……

但是，受制于石油危机的影响和对高性能 车辆的严格排放限制……

使得这款车型只投产了三个月， 总产量仅有200辆。

这辆在广告中被称为“Kenmeri”的GT-R， 从未得到参赛的机会……

但其充满戏剧性的故事意味着它是GT-R传奇中 不可或缺的一部分。

后日产暂停了赛事用GT-R 的生产……

直到1989年，16年来的第一辆GT-R诞生： 一辆基于第八代Skyline的GT-R。

其最终成果便是这款被称作R32 GT-R的车型。

它是专门针对当年的A组别赛事开发的，并配备了为其 专门生产的2.6升双涡轮增压发动机。

它还拥有日产独特的四轮驱动系统， 使其操控性可与前置后驱车相媲美。

一辆基于R32 GT-R的赛车连四年赢得了全日房车 锦标赛的全部比赛——连续赢下29场赛事！

从1969年开始，Skyline GT-R的传奇 一直延续至今……

而且还没有结束的迹象！

看来这款车确实还会书写 许多传奇！

carsEn: BMW 3.0 CSL '73; BMW M3 Coupé '03; BMW M2 Competition '18
carsZh: 宝马3.0 CSL '73; 宝马M3 Coupé '03; 宝马M2 Competition '18
descriptionEn: Collect some inline-6-powered BMWs.
descriptionZh: 收集几辆直列六缸引擎的BMW。
storyEn:
These three inline-6-powered BMWs are the picks of their respective eras. A magnificent collection indeed!

BMW, or "Bavarian Motor Works," was a company that was founded on engine-building.

Its emblem that signifies a spinning propeller suggests that the company started with aircraft engines.

In 1917, it released its first product, an inline-6 engine called the BMW IIIa.

Touted as a "perfectly balanced engine," the inline-6 layout cancelled out the rocking motion of the cylinders.

Offering high reliability and performance, it was used to power many famous airplanes.

Having made a name for itself in engine production, BMW next turned to automobiles...

...producing many renowned cars and automobile engines.

But the highest praise has always been reserved for its "smooth-as-silk" inline-6.

The E46 M3, the company's venerable sports sedan, was the last M3 to come equipped with a naturally-aspirated inline-6.

Not only is its S54 3.2-liter engine powerful and responsive, it als roars like a lion.

Although BMW also built V8s for the M3, it never abandoned the inline-6.

The M2 Competition is one excellent example of this return to form.

Propelled by a twin-turbo 3.0-liter inline-6, this compact is capable of hitting exotic-car speeds.

Tracing your way along the M family tree, you're bound to come across many great inline-6-powered cars.

And the 3.0 CSL from 1973 is definitel. one of them.

Fitted with a 3.0-liter inline-6, and later a 3.2-liter version, this machine was a major player in touring car races.

Some 130 years have passed since automobiles adopted the internal-combustion engine...

...yet few have left their mark on history quite like BMW’s ever-evolving inline-6.
storyZh:
这三辆直列六缸宝马都是它们各自时代的一时之选。 确实是一批令人艳羡的收藏！

宝马，或者说“巴伐利亚引擎制造厂”，正如其名称所示， 是一家以制造引擎起家的公司！

不过追述企业历史，其第一批引擎是为飞机， 而不是汽车设计的。

在1917年，该公司发布了其首款产品， 一台名为宝马IIIa的直列六缸引擎。

这台引擎被誉为“完美平衡的引擎”，直列六缸布局 成功消除了气缸的所有振动。

作为一台可靠性与性能俱佳的引擎，它被安装在了 数不清的著名飞机上。

成功在引擎开发史上留名之后，宝马开^进入汽车制造业……

虽然生产了许多闻名遐迩的汽车和汽车引擎，

但得到最多赞誉的永远是他们“顺滑如丝”的 直列六缸引擎车型。

E46 M3就是他们这个领域的主要成就之一，也最后一款 搭载自然吸气直列六缸引擎的M3。

这台代号S5443.2升引擎不仅响应灵敏，声势 更如狮吼般雄浑洪亮。

虽然宝马后来开始为M3搭载V8引擎，但也从未放弃过 自己的直列六缸引擎。

M2 Competition就是其回归的杰出代表之一。

它由一台3升直列六缸双涡轮增压引擎驱动， 如同一枚小巧的导弹，却能够达到火箭级的速度。

在M家族的车系中一路追溯，你还能发现 许多了不起的直列六缸车型……

而1973年的3.0 CSL必然会是其中之一。

这辆传奇汽车最初装载了一台3升直列六缸引擎， 后来又升级为3.2升，是各类房车锦标赛中的常客。

从汽车采用内燃机引擎开始，已经过去了130余年……

但很少有汽车能像宝马这些不断进化的直列六缸汽车一样， 在历史上留下鲜明的印记！

carsEn: Bugatti Veyron 16.4 '13; Bugatti Vision Gran Turismo; Bugatti Chiron '16
carsZh: 布加迪Veryron 16.4 '13; 布加迪Vision Gran Turismo; 布加迪Chiron '16
descriptionEn: Collect some legendary French Bugattis.
descriptionZh: 收集几辆充满传奇色彩的法国Bugatti。
storyEn:
Headquartered in France, Bugatti is a truly unique brand, the very name of which is nothing short of legendary.

Part of its appeal is a strong association with the most elegant and high-performing cars in the world.

Born into an artistic family in Milan, company founder Ettore Bugatti was a skilled mechanical engineer.

In 1909, he established an autmaking company in Molsheim, now part of the Alsace region of France.

Producing many excellent road and race cars, he steadily built his brand’s reputation.

The Bugatti Type 35 from 1924 is a perfect example of Ettore’s craft.

Among its 1000-plus wins were two straight wins at the Monaco Grand Prix and five at the Targa Florio.

Back then, Bugatti cars were distinguished by their bright blue bodies, a traition that continues to this day.

Ettore passed away in 1947, at which point his company ceased operations.

It wasn’t until 1987 that an Italian entrepreneur acquired the brand and revived the famed automaker.

Although Bugatti returned to the spotlight with the EB110, it once again ceased operations in 1995.

After that, Volkswagen Group stepped in to finance a third revial of the legendary brand.

Returning to Molsheim, Bugatti Automobiles once again created some of the world’s greatest cars.

Marking Bugatti’s rebirth was this Veyron 16.4.

Powered by a 1000-horsepower W-16 engine, it was capable of a top speed of .

The Bugatti brand also made history in the virtual world with the Bugatti Vision Gran Turismo.

One model of this car was actually built for Bugatti fansZ and was purchased through a secret bid.

The year 2016 saw the unveiling of the Chiron, the successor to the Veyron.

Based on the Vision Gran Turismo model, its W-16 engine was upgraded to .

Given that each Bugatti is considered a genuine work of art, you can rest assured that this collection is priceless.

storyZh:
总部设在法国的布加迪是一个真正独一无二的名牌， 永远不乏传奇故事的诞生。

它的强大魅力部分要归功于其旗下那些 世界上性能最高、设计最优雅的车型。

公司创始人埃托雷·布加迪出身于米兰的艺术世家，本人也是 一位技艺精湛的机械工程师。

1909年，他在莫{塞姆小镇（现属于法国阿尔萨斯） 创立了一家汽车制造公司。

通过生产优秀的公路车和比赛用车，他稳健地 积累了品牌的口碑。

1924年的布加迪35型是埃托雷作品的代表。

此车斩获了超过1000个冠军头衔，其中包括蝉联 摩纳哥大奖赛冠军，以及摘得塔格·佛罗热大赛的五届冠军。

当时，布加迪汽车以其亮蓝色!车身而出名， 这一传统也被保留至今。

埃托雷于1947年去世，公司经营也随之终止。

直到1987年，一位意大利企业家收购了这一品牌， 让这家有名的汽车制造商得以重获新生。

虽然布加迪凭借EB110再次获得了瞩目，但却于1995年 又一次遗憾地破产倒闭。

此后，大众集团为这个传奇名牌V入了 第三度复苏的资金。

布加迪汽车回到莫尔塞姆，开始设计出一批 在全世界范围都无与伦比的汽车。

这台布加迪Veryron 16.4正是布加迪浴火重生后的代表之作。

它搭载一台1000马力的W16引擎， 能够达到 的最高时速。

在虚拟世界里，布加迪也通过 布加迪Vision Gran Turismo创造了历史。

布加迪为车迷们专门ß产了一辆实体Vision Gran Turismo， 并通过秘密拍卖会售出。

2016年亮相的Chiron是布加迪Veryron的继任车型，

基于Vision Gran Turismo车型设计，W16引擎 的动力更是升级到了 。

每辆布加迪都被认为是艺术的杰作， 因此你可以放心，这个收藏里的车都是无价之宝。

carsEn: Honda RA272 '65; Honda S800 '66; McLaren MP4/4 '88
descriptionEn: Collect some of Honda's best-known race cars.
descriptionZh: 收集几辆Honda最出名的赛车。
storyEn:
Much of the innovation behind Honda’s engineering was driven by competition, and these three are shining examples of that!

Company founder Soichiro Honda was a firm believer in the notion that racing improves technology.

After racing motorcycles in competitions all over the world, he channeled his experience into building cars.

In 1964, one year after Honda unveiled its first production car, the T360 pickup...

...the company earned the distinction of being the first Japanese automaker to compete in Formula 1 racing.

After some hardships, Honda won its first race in the final round of its second year, the 1965 Mexican Grand Prix.

The car that made Honda’s F1 victory a reality was none other than this Honda RA272.

Honda was quick to pick up on the importance of having a designated competition track.

Looking to build Japan’s first genuine race track, Honda helped develop the Suzuka Circuit in 1962.

The Honda S series sports car was the first to compete on this track in 1964.

And it went on to achieve a lass win at the Nürburgring in Germany in the same year.

The car became an important part of Honda’s motorsports history.

As for this F1 machine, the McLaren MP4/4, it was a major player of the 1980s, an era dominated by turbo engines.

The 1988 F1 season was brutal for F1 teams that relied on turbocharged engines.

This is because 1988 was the year in which tight limits were put on turbo technologyy

Undismayed, Honda poured all of its know-how into fine-tuning the MP4/4’s turbocharged powerplant.

And with drivers Ayrton Senna and Alain Prost, McLaren won 15 of 16 races in a single year!

Indeed, this is a collection that wonderfully expresses Soichiro Honda’s ardent passion for racing!

storyZh:
竞赛是本田汽车设计革新背后最大的驱动力之一， 而这三辆车就是证明！

公司创始人本田宗一郎是“竞争提升科技” 这一观点的坚定信仰者。

在参与过全世界各项摩托车赛事之后， 他将自己的经验倾注在了汽车制造领域。

{1964年，也就是本田发布了他们的第一款 量产车——T360皮卡的一年之后……

这家公司光荣地成为了第一家参加F1锦标赛的日本车厂。

他们的征程起初并不顺利，不过在参赛次年1965年的 最后一站比赛中，车队赢下了墨西哥大奖赛的胜利。

而让本田的F1夺冠梦想成真的赛车， 正是这辆本田RA272。

它采用了本田自己设计开发!V12引擎和车身， 是赛车运动史上的一款传奇车型。

本田拥有独一无二的领悟力，很快就意识到 拥有自己的专属赛道的重要性。

他们立志于打造全日本第一个真正的赛车场， 并在1962年参与建设了铃鹿赛道。

第一批在这条铃鹿赛道上比赛的赛车中就有 于1964年亮相的本田S系列跑车。

随后，这一系列车型于U一年在德国的纽博格林赛道上 又赢下了一场组别赛事的胜利，

成为本田参与赛车运动的历史上最不可或缺的推动者。

至于这辆F1赛车——迈凯伦MP4/4，它在由 涡轮增压引擎所统治的1980年代大放异彩。

对于严重依赖强大的涡轮增压引擎的所有F1车队来说， 1988赛季尤其艰难。

因为在这一年，赛事大会针对轮增压技术实施了 极其严苛的限制。

但本田并未心灰气馁，而是调动起全部的知识和经验， 精细调校MP4/4的涡轮增压引擎。

通过与车手埃尔顿·塞纳和阿兰·普罗斯特的通力合作，

他们在那一年惊人地赢下了16场比赛中的15场， 以势不可挡之姿拿下了F1总冠军！

毋庸置疑，这一次的收藏完美߰呈现了 本田宗一郎对于赛车的诚挚热情！

carsEn: Porsche 911 Carrera RS (901) '73; Porsche 911 Carrera RS (964) '92; Porsche 911 Carrera RS Clubsport (993) '95
carsZh: 保时捷911 Carrera RS (901) '73; 保时捷911 Carrera RS (964) '92; 保时捷911 Carrera RS Clubsport (993) '95
descriptionEn: Collect some of Porsche's 911 RS models.
descriptionZh: 收集几辆Porsche的911 RS车型。
storyEn:
The Porsche 911 has been a major player on the world stage, and its unique RS model is no exception.

The "RS" stands for "Race Sport."

And all 911 Carrera RS's were designed exclusively to win races.

Compared to standard 911s, the RS is distinguished by its lightweigt, responsive chassis...

...and finely-tuned engine.

The original model was this 911 Carrera RS, which was first released in 1972.

Based on the first-generation Porsche 911, it was designed to meet FIA's homologation requirements.

Stripped of all convenience features, it came powered by an engine that was increased by from the base model's.

In terms of horsepwer and top-speed, it represented the peak of the 911 series for its time.

The RS was the first 911 production car to sport a rear spoiler, and sat on wide tires for improved traction.

As Porsche had hoped, subsequent RS variants played a significant role at international motorsports events.

The advent of the road-legal RS was a truly historical event in the history of Porsch.

Its legacy was carried on by such models as this 964 Carrera RS in 1992...

...and the 993 Carrera RS in 1995.

Each model resembles its forebearer in its dedication to being lightweight, powerful and incredibly responsive.

After more than half a century, the lasting impact of the original RS remains unchanged.

Which is why this 4ollection is bound to be the envy of sports-car enthusiasts everywhere.

storyZh:
保时捷911系列从来都是全球舞台上的重量级人物， 这款独特的RS车型也不例外。

RS代表“Race Sport”，取比赛运动型之意。顾名思义……

所有的911 Carrera RS车型都是为了赢得 汽车运动赛事而设计。

与标准911车型相比，RS最突出的优势就是 轻量化、高响应度的底盘……

以及精细调校的引擎。

系列历史上的初代型号就是这辆1972年推出的911 Carrera RS。

它基于第一代保时捷911开发， 专为满足国际汽联的赛车运动“赛事认证”规则而设计。

它拆除了所有的舒适性设备，成为了 一部斯巴达3士般的比赛机器，

就连引擎排量也比基础车型扩大了 。

无论在马力还是极速方面，它都代表了 当时911系列的性能顶峰。

它是第一款为了提升牵引力而安装了 后扰流板并采用宽胎的量产911车型。

正如保时捷所希望的那样，后续的RS改款也在 国际赛车运动领域里扮演了重要的角色。

由赛车衍生而来的RS公路车的出现 在保时捷的历史上具有划时代的意义……

后续的多款RS车型都继承了先代的精神，例如这辆 1992年推出的964 Carrera RS……

以及95年推出的993 Carrera RS。

每一款新车都延续了前辈的特点，致力于追求 极致的轻量化、强大的性能和无与伦比的反应速度。

在经历了超过半个世纪的岁月后，初代RS所代表的 激情和快感丝毫没有减退。

正因如此，这套收藏一定可以让全世界的跑车 爱好者都艳羡不已。

carsEn: Honda RA272 '65; Honda S800 '66; McLaren MP4/4 '88
descriptionEn: Collect some Toyota cars that were made for life in Japan.
descriptionZh: 收集几辆为日本国民生产的Toyota家用车。
storyEn:
These three cars were designed for families and are prized for their significant historical and cultural value.

The Toyota Crown is Japan’s representative luxury sedan. This model is a 14th-generation Crown from 2012.

Indeed, one cannot overstate the impact this car has had on Japanese auomotive history.

Its story begins in 1955, when car ownership in the country was still quite rare.

It was in this era when the Crown made its debut as Toyota’s first genuine passenger vehicle.

A decade later, it greatly contributed to Japan’s passenger-car boom.

And, by the 1980s, it had garnered an excellent reputation, as evidenced by its advertising slogan: "One day, a Crown."

The Prius is Toyota’s hybrid car. Powered by the Toyota Hybrid System (THS), it was introduced in 1997.

The Prius' drivetrain combined an engine with two motors to deliver highly efficient driving performance.

Even today, this innovative technology remains at the core of Toyota’s hybrid production strategy.

Next, we will talk about the quintessential Japanse family hauler, the minivan.

Minivans first appeared in Japan in the 1990s and were built to accommodate multiple people traveling on Japanese roads.

The tall, spacious and convenient nature of minivans, made this Japanese genre a big hit.

The Toyota Alphard was among the most desired. It stands out as a representative example of Japanese minivan culture.

Because of their high level of 4omfort, many minivans have become regarded as luxury vehicles.

And at the top of the list is the stylish and premium Toyota Alphard.

And it is only getting more popular every year, not just in Japan but all over the world.

This collection gives you a sense of Toyota’s automotive history and Japanese car culture in general.
storyZh:
这三辆车专为日本的日常生活所打造，也因其 拥有重要的历史和文化价值而备受珍视。

丰田皇冠是日本最具代表性的豪华车品牌之一。 这个型号是2012年推出的14代皇冠。

不夸张地讲，没人能小觑这个品牌在 日本汽车历中留下的重要影响。

它的故事始于1955年，那时这个国家 能够拥有私家车的人还属凤毛麟角。

正是在这样的大环境下，皇冠作为丰田的第一款 纯正乘用车而登上历史舞台。

十年之后，它又对日本的私家车普及 做出了重大贡献……

而到了二十世纪八十年代，这个型号又成为了所有人倾慕的座驾， 他_的宣传口号就证明了这一点：“一天一皇冠”。

而这辆普锐斯则是丰田的一款混合动力车型。这辆车于1997年 首次推出，由丰田混动系统提供动力。

“丰田混动系统”结合了一部引擎和两部电机， 输出效率和性能都相当卓越。

即便到今天，这种创新性的控制技术依然在 丰田的混合生产策略中扮演核心*角色。

继续看下一辆。日式家用车的精髓 在这辆厢式旅行车身上体现无疑。

厢式旅行车最初在二十世纪九十年代在日本出现， 专为在日本的道路上运送大量乘客所设计。

这种日本的独特车型可以提供“移动起居室”的体验， 因此开始风靡世界。

丰田埃尔法就这样的一辆车，也是日本厢式旅行车 文化中最具代表性的榜样。

除了具备舒适性外，厢式旅行车还在“豪华车”领域分到了一杯羹。

现在，埃尔法已经成为了“豪华”的代名词， 也是日本消费者心目中梦寐以求的车。

而且不仅在日本，它在全世界的人气也与日俱增！

这套收藏可以让你对丰田的车历史 和日本汽车文化惊鸿一瞥。

carsEn: Ford GT40 Mark I '66; Ford GT '06; Ford GT '17
carsZh: 福特GT40 Mark I '66; 福特GT '06; 福特GT '17
descriptionEn: Collect some legendary Ford GTs, and become the envy of car enthusiasts everywhere.
descriptionZh: 收集几辆传奇的Ford GT，成为全世界车迷嫉妒的对象。
storyEn:
The Ford GT is celebrated the world over as one of the greatest race cars in motorsports history.

Here we have a 1960s original Ford GT Mk I, and its second-gen successor.

This is an incredible collection that is sure to be the envy of any serious gearhead.

History buffs are surely aware of Ford’s fascinating racing history.

...entered one of his cars in a U.S. race, unexpectedly defeating his more successful rival.

It was a brilliant show of endurance and speed that put Ford on the map in competition endurance racing.

In the 1960s, Ford placed its focus on the Le Mans 24-hour race.

After partnering with veteran British engineering firm Lola Cars, Ford established Ford Advanced Vehicles.

In 1964, the company then unveiled a prtotype race car called the "Ford GT."

Although it was developed to win at Le Mans...

...a mass-production version was offered the following year.

Then came the GT Mk I, and its mere 40-inch height led to it being named the "GT40."

An important contributor to the Ford GT Le Mans project...

...was the legendary U.S. race car driver and master automotive developer Carroll Shelby.

With Shelby’s help, an improved ariant, called the Mk II, appeared in 1966.

This car brought Ford a fabulous victory at Le Mans.

Notably, that win not only unseated Ferrari as the reigning Le Mans champion...

...but the GT40 did so in absolutely dominant fashion, finishing 1-2-3!

From then until 1969, Ford introduced new variants and scored four con$ecutive Le Mans victories...

...securing its legacy in the annals of motorsport history.

This legacy has continued into the 21st century...

...particularly in the form of this Ford GT, introduced in 2005 to mark the company's centennial.

It reimagined the beautiful form of the 1960s' GT40 with state-of-the-art technology.

This second-coming of the mid-engine Le Mans winner had a stunning design and awesome performan e.

But the legend of the Ford GT did not stop there...

...because a more evolved GT was unveiled in 2015.

This new model competed in the 2016 Le Mans, where it pulled off a stunning class victory.

This achievement happened to mark the 50th anniversary of Ford’s first Le Mans win.

The Ford GT is a rare breed of sports car that shined on the world stage for more than half a century.

storyZh:
作为赛车运动史上最伟大的成就之一， 福特GT得到了全世界的盛誉。

在这里的是一辆1960年代产初代福特GT Mk I， 以及它的第二代后续车型。

这两辆车都是非常了不起的收藏品， 一定会让所有硬核汽车迷艳羡不已。

汽车历史爱好者想必都对福特那令人;往的赛车史如数家珍。

在1901年，公司的创始人亨利·福特……

派出他的一辆汽车参与了一项美国赛事， 并意外地击败了实力更为强大的对手。

那是一场耐力与速度的精彩演出， 也确立了福特参与赛车运动的传统。

在上世纪60年代，福特开始布局勒芒24小时耐力赛。

福特和经验老到的英国工程公司罗拉赛车合作， 设立了福特高级车辆公司Y…

到了1964年，他们公布了一款名为“福特GT”的原型赛车。

这款车最初的设计目的就是为了在勒芒夺魁……

它的量产型号也在下一年亮相。

这款量产车便是GT Mk I，而它仅有40英寸高的车身 也让它得名“GT40”。

传奇美国赛车手兼汽车设计大师卡罗尔·谢尔比……

也是福特GT勒芒项目的一名重要贡献者。

在谢U比的帮助下，一款改良型号——Mk II于1966年登场亮相……

并在勒芒为福特拿下了一场美妙的胜利。

最值得一提的是，这场胜利不仅将统治勒芒的 冠军车厂法拉利赶下了宝座……

还创下了令人不可思议的包揽前三名之壮举， 秀出了福特那压倒性的实力！

从那一年起直到1969年，福特不断推出新款赛车， 并成功在勒芒拿下了四连冠……

巩固了自己在赛车运动史上不可磨灭的地位。

这份光荣传统在21世纪得到了延续。

比如这辆2005年亮相的福特GT， 标志着福特汽车的百年历史。

它以当时最先进的科技重新构想了60年代 GT40那美轮美奂的外观。

这款再次以中布局称霸勒芒的冠军车型也 拥有无出其右的精美外观。

不过，福特GT的传奇并未就此停下脚步……

一款全新进化的福特GT在2015年盛大登场。

新车参加了2016年的勒芒比赛， 并以独步天下的英姿拿下了胜利。

这项佳绩恰好为福特在勒芒首次夺冠 的50周年纪念送上了完美的礼物。

诚然，福特GT已经成为独树一帜的跑车族， 在世界舞台上闪耀超过半个世纪。

carsEn: Shelby Cobra 427 '66; Shelby G.T.350 '65; Ford Shelby GT350R '16
carsZh: Shelby Cobra 427 '66; Shelby G.T.350 '65; 福特Shelby GT350R '16
descriptionEn: Collect some of the most legendary cars to ever wear the "Shelby" badge.
descriptionZh: 收集几台拥有“Shelby”名号的传奇车辆。
storyEn:
The name of the Shelby American car company originated from its founder, Carroll Shelby.

Shelby worked his way up from the amateur ranks to become an icon who competed in Formula 1 and at Le Mans.

But perhaps he is better known as one of America's most cherished race-car designers.

One of Shelby's greatet achievements as a designer...

...happened in 1961 when he ordered a race-car chassis from Britain's AC Cars.

This chassis was fitted with a Ford V-8 engine and took the name Shelby Cobra.

It dominated sports-car races of the 1960s becoming a legend in the American racing scene.

Among the most celebrated of all of Shelby's creations is the 427 Cobra.

With a 7.0-liter V-8 engine fitted into its cassic yet robust body, it snatched the podium in numerous races.

Shelby's efforts did not end with the Cobra, he also transformed the production Ford Mustang into a high-performance muscle car.

The most well-known model is this 1965 Shelby GT 350, a homologation car developed to dominate the race track.

With a displacement of 289 cubic inches, or 4.7 liters, this V-8 masterpiece turned the Mustang into a frmidable classic.

Carroll Shelby passed away in 2012, but his legacy and his spirit live on in these cars.

Take for example the 2016 Ford Shelby GT350R, which took the already nimble modern Mustang...

...and made it lighter, tuning the entire car, from the engine to the chassis, to make it a true Shelby.

Carroll Shelby was, after all, the man who helped the Ford GT40 conq"er Le Mans in the 1960s.

This wonderful collection will show you his extraordinary passion for cars and enthusiasm for racing.
storyZh:
Shelby品牌的名字不言自明，来自于一个叫 卡罗尔·谢尔比的美国人。

谢尔比从业余联赛车手起步，通过自己的不懈努力 最终成为了参与F1和勒芒的传奇赛车手。

另外，他也是一名让全美国都引以为傲的知名赛车设计师。

他作为汽车0计师最伟大的成就之一……

始于1961年，当时他从英国的AC汽车公司 订购了一台赛车底盘。

然后在底盘上安装了一部福特V8引擎， 而这件作品就是后世众所周知的Shelby Cobra。

这款车统治了二十世纪六十年代的跑车赛事， 并成为了美国赛车界的传奇。

不过在所有Shelby Cobra车型中， 最著名的当属427 Cobra。

在它经典而皮实的车身下，是一台全新的7升V8引擎， 帮助它在无数场比赛中登上了领奖台。

除了Cobra之外，谢尔比还将福特野马 打造成了一辆高性能肌肉车。

其中最著名的车款就是这辆1965款Shelby GT350， 它是一辆专为统治赛道而生的赛事认证车。

这款杰作采用一台289立方英寸，或者说4.7升V8引擎， 让野马成了不可替代的一代经典。

卡罗尔·谢尔比在2012年辞世，不过他却为汽车行业 留下了宝贵的财富，他的精神也流传了下来。

2016款福特Shelby GT350R就充分地继承了他的遗产。 这款车的研发基于操控灵活、敏捷的现代野马……

进一步减轻了车重，从引擎到底盘对全车各处 进行深度调校，将其打造成了一部真正的She;by。

卡罗尔·谢尔比——帮助福特GT40在 二十世纪六十年代征服勒芒的男人。

这套美妙的收藏将会为你展示他对于汽车的无上热情 和对于比赛的执着热爱。

carsEn: Alpine A110 1600S '72; Alpine Vision Gran Turismo Race Mode; Alpine A110 Première Édition '17
carsZh: 阿尔派A110 1600S '72; 阿尔派Vision Gran Turismo Race Mode7; 阿尔派A110首发版'17
descriptionEn: Collect some cars built by Alpine, a famous manufacturer from France, the birthplace of motorsport.
descriptionZh: 收集由赛车运动起源地法国的著名汽车制造商Alpine生产的车辆。
storyEn:
Surely every car enthusiast has heard of the name "Alpine."

France is known as the birthplace of motorsports, so it makes sense that the company was founded there.

Alpine has always had a unique approach to sports car design, it is recognized for its impressive team of race engineers.

Jean Rédélé was still a young man when he founded the company.

While working at a Renault garage...

...he competed in races with a Renault 4CV that he had tuned himself.

His excellent skills behind the steering wheel shined at the Mille Miglia and other major events.

In 1955, Rédélé established his own brand, Alpine, which was named after the Cupe des Alpes.

In 1963, Alpine officially began building race cars for Renault under the moniker "Alpine Renault."

One of the most successful sports cars to bear the Alpine name is this Alpine A110.

The striking design of the rear-engine compact sports car made it a symbol for the brand.

The A110’s status as a formidable racer was established at internationa rallies.

In 1971, it claimed a 1-2-3 finish at Monte Carlo, and in 1973, it won the inaugural World Rally Championship.

Although Alpine took a back seat to Renault in sports car development throughout the 1990s...

...the brand was revived in 2016 with an all-new A110.

Rumor has it that this car was designed using Rédélé’s original as 6 point of reference.

And indeed, elements of past A110s and Alpine’s history as a whole are clearly evident.

Today, Alpine’s unsurpassed motorsport history and design philosophy...

...are marvelously expressed in the Alpine Vision Gran Turismo.

Truly, this is a magnificent collection of some of France’s most iconic automotive treasures.
storyZh:
每一个车迷肯定都听说过“阿尔派”这个品牌。

阿尔派成立于二十世纪五十年代的法国， 这里也是赛车运动的诞生地……

阿尔派在跑车设计上的思路总是与众不同， 其麾下的精锐赛车工程师团队也举世闻名。

在创立这家公司时，让·雷德尔还相当年轻。

当时他在一座雷诺汽车修理厂工作……

同时也开着一辆自己调校的雷诺4CV四处参加比赛。

他开着这辆高性能雷诺在一千英里耐力赛 和其他各项重大赛事中为自己打响了名声。

在1955年，雷德尔创立了自己的品牌阿尔派， 这个名字3来源于阿尔卑斯山拉力赛。

在1963年，阿尔派正式开始以“阿尔派雷诺”的名义 为雷诺开发赛车。

阿尔派旗下最成功的一款跑车就是这辆阿尔派A110。

这是一辆后置引擎的紧凑型跑车，而其美观的设计 也成为了这一品牌的标志性符号。

A110的传奇地位是在各项国际拉力赛上赢+来的。

在1971年，它在蒙特卡洛包揽了前三名，而在1973年， 它又赢得了首届世界拉力锦标赛。

阿尔派的跑车开发业务在整个二十世纪九十年代 退居于雷诺之后……

但在2016，这个品牌又得以重振，并推出了全新一代A110。

这款新车的设计明显大量参考了雷德尔̈́初代型号……

并且从车头到车尾都遵循着A110和阿尔派的历史。

而现如今，阿尔派那传奇版的赛车运动历史和设计理念……

又通过这辆阿尔派Vision Gran Turismo 得到了充分地体现。

这套伟大的收藏为大家忠实展现了 法国汽车行业中最璀璨的一颗明珠。

descriptionEn: Collect some custom cars that have won SEMA GT awards.
descriptionZh: 收集几台赢得过美国汽车用品改装车展览会GT大奖的改装车。
storyEn:
This is a collection of awesome cars that have won the "SEMA Gran Turismo Award"...

...that celebrates cool, high-performance cars.

If you're wondering what SEMA is, it stands for Specialty Equipment Market Association...

...a group establised in 1963 to bring together businesses involved in the manufacturing...

...and marketing of high-performance automotive parts.

And, they put on the famous SEMA Show, an automotive aftermarket trade show...

...held in Las Vegas every year on the first week of November.

The SEMA GT Award was a title presented by Gran Turismo that was part of a sponsorship deal that began in 2003.

In the U.S. there has long beena deep-rooted culture of car customization and performance tuning.

American car enthusiasts improved the performance and style of their cars, beginning with hot rods in the 1930s.

The SEMA GT Award pays homage to the shining jewels of this custom car culture.

It provides fans around the world the chance to experience these cars through Gran Turismo.

This Mach Forty wa the recipient of the GT Award in 2012, produced by Eckert's Rod and Custom of Oregon.

At first, glance it looks like a 1969 Ford Mustang...

...but on the inside, it's a monster machine with a mid-mounted Ford GT V-8 engine!

The SEMA GT Award has been given not only to American hot rods, but to European- and Japanese-tuned cars as well.

The Fugu Z based on the Nissan 240Z is a winner from 2015, and its owner Sung Kang is an a4tor from the "Fast and the Furious" movies.

The Rocket Bunny body kit is especially menacing...

...and the car comes powered by a naturally-aspirated version of the famed RB26 Skyline GT-R engine.

More than a few winners of the SEMA GT Awards began life as unassuming road cars...

...but then transformed into tarmac-eating monster machines.

The 2018 winner by the Greening Auto Company...

...took a relatively compact Ma5erick and turned it into a hot rod.

It was packed with a fully tuned 427 cu-in. V-8, which resulted in a 200-mph top speed (approx. 322km/h)!

It’s all about seeing how far you can take your dreams with your car...

...and the SEMA GT Award is a perpetual embodiment of that endeavor.

^
storyZh:
“SEMA超跑大奖”专门颁发给外形炫酷、性能强大的汽车， 而这批收藏中就包含几辆曾经赢得过这项大奖的顶尖名车。

如果你还不知道SEMA是什么，我可以科普一下， 这几个字母代表“美国汽车用品改装车协会”

该组织成立于1963年，旨在联合美国所有制造和经营 高性能汽车配件的企业和改装厂。

这个协会于每年11月的第一周在拉斯维加斯举办全球知名的 汽车副厂零件展销活动——“美国汽车用品改装车展览会”。

而“SEMA超跑大奖”则是一项自2003年起由作为赞助方之一的 《跑车浪漫旅》所颁发的奖项。

美国在汽车改装以及性能调校方面拥有着 历史悠久且根深蒂固的文化。

美国车迷们热衷于提升他们汽车的性能和外观， 这种“改装车”文化早在1930年代就已见端倪，

而“SEMA超跑大奖”的创立就是为了向 改装车文化王冠上的这颗明珠致敬，

并通过《跑车浪漫旅》向全世界的车迷们 提供体验这些改装X的机会。

这辆由埃克特改装车和俄勒冈定制所打造的 Mach Forty是2012年超跑大奖的获奖者。

粗略来看，它和1969款福特Mustang非常相似，

但骨子里却是安装了一台中置福特GT V8引擎的怪兽比赛机器。

“SEMA超跑大奖”并不是美国改装车的专属， 欧洲和日本的改装车也有机会获得这项殊荣。

基于日产240Z造的这辆Fugu Z是2015年的奖项得主， 而且它的主人正是出演了《速度与激情》系列的著名影星姜成镐！

全套火箭兔车身套件上身后，显得威慑感十足，

车体内则安装了享有盛誉的RB26天际线GT-R 引擎的自然进气版本。

在当选“SEMA超跑大奖”的获奖作品中，还有为数不少是将 原本平平无奇的公路车打造成彻头彻尾的性能怪兽。

I2018年的获奖者由格林宁汽车公司带来，

他们将一辆相对紧凑的Maverick改头换面。

这辆车配备了全面调校、排量4.27升的福特V8引擎， 能带来高达200英里/小时（约每小时322公里）的极速！

改装车的一切意义就在于让你的车承载着你的梦想向远方奔驰，

而“SEMA超跑大奖”正是这项追求的永恒体现。

carsEn: BMW M3 Sport Evolution '89; Ford Sierra RS 500 Cosworth '87; Nissan GT-R NISMO (R32) '90
carsZh: 宝马M3 Sport Evolution '89; 福特Sierra RS 500 Cosworth '87; 日产GT-R NISMO (R32) '90
descriptionEn: Collect some shining examples of the historic ‘Group A’ touring car category.
descriptionZh: 收集几台来自充满历史意义的房车组别“A组别”的杰出榜样。
storyEn:
Everyone who knows about international touring car racing knows about the legendary Group A class.

Touring car races are competitions for road-going cars that have been modified for racing.

What this means is that these events feature racing versions of cars that are sold to the public.

The cars here are three absolute legends from Group A history.

One requirement for the Group A class is the production of homologation cars.

While the number has changed over the years, the requirement that Group A cars be mass-produced has not.

When the regulations were introduced in the 1980s, the idea was to make Group A cars from production cars.

Then something unexpected happened.

Automakers with Group A ambitions began building powerful base cars for homologaion.

This meant that ordinary road-going cars were being built as world-class touring cars.

The BMW M3 E30 from 1985 was one of Germany’s most iconic Group A cars.

It featured an upgraded engine displacement, and the evolution model had aerodynamic and cooling tweaks.

Built by Ford Europe, the Sierra Cosworth RS500 featured a tuned engine from Cosworth, who specializes in race engines.

Only 500 units were produced of tis car for Group A homologation.

The Nissan Skyline GT-R R32 from 1989 is another legendary production car that was built to win races.

Beginning in 1990, it famously scored 29 straight victories at the All Japan Touring Car Championship.

This NISMO model, built by Nissan Motorsport, has a near mythical status for all of its racing modifications.

As Group A regulations fell out of fashion in the late 1990s, the need to buildwextreme production cars declined.

That said, we should be thankful that it gave us such amazing road-going examples like these here.
storyZh:
所有熟悉国际房车赛事规则的人 都对拥有传奇地位的“A组别”推崇备至。

房车赛指的是由进行过赛车化改装的公路汽车所参加的赛事。

换句话说，这种比赛就是把大家都能购买到的汽车带到赛道上， 展开激烈的竞速。

这三辆车就是A组别历史上赫赫有名的传奇。

要通过A组别赛事认证，其中一项门槛就是产量要求。

尽管具体生产数量要求多年以来经历过数次变动， 但参赛车辆必须是量产车这一条件却雷打不动。

当这条规则在二十世纪八十年代推出时，其目的就是为了 让A组汽车从适合比赛的量产汽车中脱颖而出。

然而，让人意想不到的是，

为了在A组别中斩获胜利7各大汽车制造商 开始打造性能强大的基础车型以通过认证。

也就是说他们以世界级房车的标准设计出了 许多常规的公路车型。

这款1985年推出的宝马M3 E30就是德国 最具标志性的A组别车型之一。

它的引擎排量进行了升级，而各种衍生型号还进行了 空气动力学和散热方面的调校。

而这款由福特欧洲打造的Sierra Cosworth RS500 采W了由专业赛车引擎制造商考斯沃斯进行调校的引擎。

为了通过A组别认证，这台车仅仅生产了共计500台。

1989年推出的日产Skyline GT-R R32则是另一款 专为胜利打造的传奇量产车。

从1990年开始，它在全日本GT锦标赛上 达成了举世闻名的29连胜。

这辆NISMO型号是由日产 Motorsport打造，它那全方位的 赛车化改造助其获得了神话般的地位。

遗憾的是，随着A组别规则在二十世纪九十年代后期渐渐没落， 打造高性能量产车的需求也逐渐下滑。

尽管如此，A组别还是为我们留下了如此众多 不可思议的传奇车型，我们应该永远心怀感激。

carsEn: Subaru Impreza Coupe WRX Type R STi Version VI '99; Subaru Impreza Sedan WRX STi '04; Subaru WRX STI Type S '14
carsZh: 斯巴鲁翼豹Coupe WRX Type R STi Version VI '99; 斯巴鲁翼豹轿车WRX STi '04; 斯巴鲁WRX STI S型'14
descriptionEn: Collect some Subaru WRXs, superstars of the World Rally Championship.
descriptionZh: 收集几辆世界拉力锦标赛上的超级明星——Subaru WRX。
storyEn:
Many rally fans know about the Subaru WRX’s stellar performance at the World Rally Championships (WRC).

What is not so known is that the WRX takes its name from a Subaru car from the 1970s.

I’m talking about the Leone RX, a passenger car that was introduced in 1970.

It made its claim to fame in 1974 with an overall victory at the notoriously callenging Japan Alpine Rally.

In later years, Subaru experienced remarkable success on the world rally stage.

One famous car that resulted from its achievements was the first-generation Impreza WRX.

Its name was contrived by "WR" that stood for "World Rally," and "RX," which referred to the legendary Leone.

The first-generation Impreza WRX was a small-but-tough car equippedwith a mighty turbo engine and 4-wheel-drive.

During the 1990s, it won several WRC championships, cementing its name in the annals of world rally history.

This second-generation WRX, developed to carry on its predecessor’s legacy, achieved its own rally successes.

In addition to being the last Impreza to win a WRC drivers’ championship in 2003...

...it pulled off a marvelous victory at the 2004 Rally Japan, the first WRC event to be held on Japnese soil.

In 2014, the WRX was reborn as the Subaru WRX, a new sports sedan...

...which has competed in the world’s most demanding races, including the Nürburgring 24 Hours.

The WRX ranks at the top of every Subaru sports-car enthusiast, making this a splendid collection indeed.
storyZh:
每个车迷都可以对Sufaru WRX在丑界拉力铦标貛 上的非凡表现如数家珍。

但鲜有人知晓WRX这个后字其实来源于 二十丑纪七十年代的一款Subaru汽车。

这款车就是1970年推债的乘用车Leone RX。

在以残酷性著称的Japan Alpine拉力赛上大获全胜后， 这款车在1974年名噪一时。

在之后的几年里，Subaru在全球拉力赛舞台上 持续拿出值得称道的表现。

为了赢得比赛，这家车厂付出了巨大的努力， 初代Impreza WRX就是在此过程中应运而生的一款著名车型。

这个名字由代表“世界拉力赛”的“WR”和 向Subaru传奇车型Leone致敬的“RX”组合而成。

第一代Impreza WRX造型小巧但性能强大， 配备有强劲的涡轮增压引擎和四轮驱动系统。

在二十世纪九十年代，它多次赢下WRC冠军头ꡔ， 将自己的名字牢牢地镌刻在了世界拉力赛历史上。

基于前代车型的伕秀基因而打造的第二代TRX 也在拉力赛领域取志了廞于婃自己的辉煌。 它不仅在2003鹴䕺整个Impreza家旄最后一欦 赢得了WRC眄躦手瀻冠军䀦…

还于2004年在日本本土乹劙的஬场SRC赛事 ——日本拹力锦标赛上奇迹般夺冠。

并参加了全萃多项最臛刻的赛事， 包括纽博格林24鰾时耐力赛。

WRX韯Subaru貛车爱奿耇必㸍可尖的万꾆车， 也赉予了这套䔷藏⸚同ᇡ响的鿷债咁意湉。

carsEn: Mitsubishi Lancer Evolution Final Edition '15; Mitsubishi Lancer Evolution III GSR '95; Mitsubishi Lancer Evolution VI GSR T.M. EDITION Special Color Package '99
carsZh: 三菱蓝瑟翼豪陆神最终版'15; 三菱蓝瑟翼豪陆神III GSR '95; 三菱蓝瑟翼豪陆神VI GSR T.M. EDITION Special Color Package '99
descriptionEn: Collect some rally-worthy Mitsubishi Lancer Evolutions.
descriptionZh: 收集几辆拥有优秀拉力性能的Mitsubishi Lance Evolution。
storyEn:
Way back in the medieval age of Europe, knights competed on horseback to see...

..who could reach their lord the fastest in a type of "proto-rally race."

Flash forward to recent times, and, in a way, you’ll find the Mitsubishi Lancer Evolution carried on that tradition.

A brand with deep roots in racing, Mitsubishi participated in international rallies beginning in the 1960s.

From 1983, its 4WD Pajero scored numerous victories at the Dakar Rally, considered the world’s toughest off-road race.

And the Colt and Galant both experienced much success at the World Rally Championship, which began in 1973.

Thi turbocharged 4WD Lancer Evolution made its debut in 1993, at the height of the company's racing prowess.

At the time, the top category in the WRC consisted of Group A cars, or largely unmodified production cars.

Based on the Lancer mid-size sedan, the "Evo" was created as a competition machine from the get-go.

In addition to its numerous victories at the WRC, this Evo...

...enjoyed an intense rivalry with the Subaru Impreza, another Japanese rally powerhouse.

This 1995 Lancer Evolution III is the third-generation model.

It was the car that handed ace rally driver Tommi Mäkinen his first world rally drivers title.

That same year Mitsubishi introduced the true second-generation Lancer Evolution.

Joining the Lancer Evolution VI lineup was a special version called the Tommi Mäkinen Edition.

As Mitsubishi's ace pilot, Mäkinen was the first driver in WRC history to win four consecutive drivers titles.

Therefore, the commemorative model that bears his name is undeniably special.

By the time the Evo X went on sale in 2007, Mitsubishi had withdrawn from the WRC.

Therefore, the "X" was the last Evo to be offered. And due its amazing performance, it will be remembered.

A Japanese WRC legend, the Lancer Evolution is a name etched in the annals of world automotive history.
storyZh:
在以前的欧洲中世纪，骑士们会骑乘战马展开竞技……

这可以算作是“最原始的拉力”比赛， 看谁能够更快地赶到他们的领主身旁。

时间快进到现代赛车运动，你会发现 三菱蓝瑟翼豪陆神便继承了这种传统。

三菱这个品牌深深植根于赛车运动，自从 二十世纪六十年代起便一直参与国际拉力赛事。

从1983年算起，品牌旗下的四驱车帕杰罗在全世界最艰苦的 越野赛事——达喀尔拉力赛中多次夺魁……

另外，其小马和格兰特车型也在1973年创始的 世界拉力锦标赛中取得过辉煌的成功。

这款涡轮增压的四驱蓝瑟翼豪陆神在这家车厂位于 实力巅峰的1993年首次亮相。

当时，世界拉力锦标赛的顶级组别仅限于组别A赛车 ——即基本未经改装的量产车参加。

“翼豪陆神”车型基于中型轿车蓝瑟所打造， 在量产车型阶段便已经为参加拉力赛做好了准备。

除了在世<拉力锦标赛的无数胜利之外， 这款“翼豪陆神”车型……

也因为和当时日本的另外一款伟大车型斯巴鲁翼豹 之间的良性竞争而著称。

这辆1995年发布的蓝瑟翼豪陆神III是翼豪陆神的第三代车型。

正是这台享誉世界的赛车帮助三菱的王牌车手 托米·马基宁拿下了他的第一个世界拉力锦标赛车手冠ћ。

同一年里，车型的改款升级也标志着Evo“真正”进入第二阶段。

蓝瑟翼豪陆神VI: 汤米·马基宁版便是这一革命性 飞跃的体现。

三菱的王牌车手托米·马基宁是世界拉力锦标赛 历史上第一个连续四年夺得车手冠军的人。

而这款以他名字命名的纪念车也理所当然 是一份真正的宝藏。

当翼豪陆神X在2007年开始发售时，三菱已经 退出了世界拉力锦标赛。

作为最后一款翼豪陆神，X的S-AWC系统和强大的涡轮增压引擎 让它成为了一款备受珍视且历久弥新的运动轿车。

作为日本拉力传奇，蓝瑟翼豪陆神的名字 早已被镌刻在了世界汽车历史上。

carsEn: Maserati A6GCS/53 Spyder '54; Maserati Merak SS '80; Maserati MC20 '20
carsZh: 玛莎拉蒂A6GCS/53 Spyder '54; 玛莎拉蒂Merak SS '80; 玛莎拉蒂MC20 '20
descriptionEn: Collect some Maseratis and celebrate the brand's century-long history.
descriptionZh: 为了庆祝Maserati超过一个世纪的辉煌历史，收集几辆该品牌汽车。
storyEn:
Maserati’s story begins more than a century ago in the Italian city of Bologna.

In 1914, Alfieri, Ettore, and Ernesto Maserati decided to establish an automotive garage.

Thanks to Alfieri’s racing talent, the family-run garage quickly grew into a profitable business.

A collaborator on Isotta-Fraschini sports cars, Maserati displayed the Trident fr the first time in the mid-1920s.

It appeared on the Tipo 26.

Although Maserati machines were exceptionally fast, Grand Prix racing was becoming more and more expensive.

In need of financial support, the family-run business was sold to the Modena industrialist Adolfo Orsi in 1937.

Relocated to Modena, Maserati entered a golden age in post-war racing of the 1950s.

During this time, Juan Manuel Fangio, Stirling Mos, and other racing greats...

...piloted Maserati F1 machines to countless Grand Prix victories.

Making its debut in 1953, at the height of this golden age, was the A6GCS/53 Spyder.

This legendary car raced for the Maserati works team in the 1954 season.

In the 1960s, Maserati shifted gears, pun unintended, from race cars to road cars.

Unveiled in 1972, this mid-engine 2+2 sports car drove the company’s busines for the next 12 years.

In the 1990s, Maserati was acquired by FIAT, which turned management over to Ferrari.

This MC20, released in 2020, was a dream-like supercar worthy of the Maserati name.

It was the first Maserati in a long while to run on an engine entirely developed in-house.

A dream come true, it used a bit of F1-tech called "pre-chamber" to improve efficiency.

Clearly, the passion and creativity of t?e Maserati Brothers is alive and well in the 21st century!
storyZh:
玛莎拉蒂的故事开始于一个多世纪以前的 意大利城市博洛尼亚。

1914年，阿尔菲力、埃托雷和厄内斯托·玛莎拉蒂决定 开设一家汽车修理厂。

得益于阿尔菲力的赛车天赋，这家家族经营的修车厂 很快便盈利颇丰。

在二十世纪二十年代中期，玛莎拉蒂与伊索塔弗拉西"公司 合作开发跑车，其三叉戟标志也首次亮相人前。

提波26便是双方合作的产物。

尽管玛莎拉蒂赛车拥有骄人的速度，但参加大奖赛的开销 也越发高昂。

由于缺乏资金支持，这家家族企业不得不在1937年被 出售给了摩德纳企业家阿道夫·奥尔西。

在搬迁到摩德纳后，玛莎拉蒂在二十世纪五十年代的 战后赛车运动领域R入“黄金时代”。

在此期间，胡安·曼努埃尔·方吉奥、斯特灵·莫斯 以及其他伟大的赛车手……

驾驶着玛莎拉蒂打造的F1赛车赢得了无数场大奖赛胜利。

站上这个黄金时代巅峰的便是1953年 首次亮相的A6GCS/53 Spyder。

这辆传奇赛车在1954赛季为玛莎拉蒂厂队出战。

在二十世纪六十年代，玛莎拉蒂开始变更赛道， 从专注于制造赛车改为制造5路车。

这辆于1972年亮相的中置引擎2+2跑车在接下来的 12年里一直是公司的拳头产品。

到了二十世纪九十年代，玛莎拉蒂被菲亚特收购， 经营管理权也转交到了法拉利手中。

这辆2020年推出的MC20是一款不辱玛莎拉蒂盛名的梦幻超跑。

这是品牌回归的数十年里，首款采用 完全内部开发的引擎的玛莎拉蒂车型。

为了ؐ升引擎效率，它采用了一种被称为“预燃室”的F1技术， 仿若梦想照进了现实。

很显然，玛莎拉蒂兄弟们的热情和创意 直到二十一世纪依然生机勃勃。

carsEn: Aston Martin DB5 '64; Aston Martin DB11 '16; Aston Martin Valkyrie '21
carsZh: 阿斯顿·马丁DB5 '64; 阿斯顿·马丁DB11 '16; 阿斯顿·马丁Valkyrie '21
descriptionEn: Collect some Aston Martins and celebrate the brand's longstanding commitment to producing the very best in sports car design.
descriptionZh: 为了纪念Aston Martin长期以来一直致力于打造最优秀的跑车，收集几辆该品牌汽车。
storyEn:
One of Britain’s most famous automakers, Aston Martin, has continually produced the world's finest luxury sports cars.

This company with a long-celebrated history dates back to 1913.

It was in this year that Robert Bamford and Lionel Martin founded the company, Bamford & Martin.

When their first sports car, the "Coal Suttle," won the Aston Hill Climb in West London...

...the name "Aston Martin" was born, a nod to the site of their victory and one of the company founders.

Since then, Aston Martin has been very active in motorsports.

The legendary DBR1 had countless victories, most famously at the 1959 24 Hours of Le Mans.

The company rose to even greater heights under the post-war leadership of David Brown.

So great were Brown’s contributions that his initials grace the names of Aston Martin cars to this day.

Unveiled in 1963, the DB5 represents the company’s golden age.

In addition to its Superleggera body by Touring and high-performance inline-6 engine...

...it was driven by Sean Connery in the hit film, "Goldfinger," making it world-famous as James Bond's car.

In the 21st century, Aston MartinRs cars set their sights on the future.

A perfect example of this is the DB11 from 2016, in which honed craft combined with pure innovation.

As the first turbocharged Aston, it came powered by a V-12 as well as a V-8 developed by Mercedes-AMG.

This marked the beginning of Aston Martin’s experimentation with F1 technology.

Released alongside the DB11, this Valkyrie, collaboratively built by Red Bull Racing, was the ultimate hypercar.

Feat"ring an all-carbon body and over- of power, this race-ready machine was designed to be road-legal!

With 110 years of history, Aston Martin continues to create luxury sports cars that are the envy of all.
storyZh:
英国最著名的汽车制造商阿斯顿马丁曾经打造出 无数款独一无二的豪华跑车。

这家历史悠久的公司的起源最早可追溯到1913年。

在这一年，罗伯特·班福德和莱昂内尔·马丁 联手创立了班福特 & 马丁公司。

当他们的第一辆跑车“Coal Scuttle”在西8敦的 阿斯顿爬山赛中获胜之后……

“阿斯顿马丁”的品牌名便诞生了，以向他们获胜的场地和 公司创始人致敬。

自那之后，阿斯顿马丁便开始倾注全力参加赛车运动。

传奇车型DBR1取得过无数的胜利，其中最著名的一次 便是1959年的勒芒24小时耐力赛。

战后在大卫·布朗的领导下，公司更是发展到了无与伦比\高度。

这份成就是如此伟大，乃至于布朗名字的首字母“DB”被加入到了 阿斯顿马丁车型的命名中，一直延续至今。

1963年亮相的DB5是这家公司“黄金时代” 的辉煌象征。

它除了采用由图尔灵车身制造公司设计的超轻车身 和高性能直列6缸引擎之外……

还得到了大银幕特工詹姆斯·邦德的青睐， 以“007座驾”的身份享誉球。

到了二十一世纪，阿斯顿马丁设计的车型 开始将目光着眼于未来。

2016年推出的DB11结合了千锤百炼的工艺和纯粹的创新， 就是最完美的例证。

作为第一款采用涡轮增压技术的阿斯顿马丁，它推出了 采用V12引擎和采用与梅赛德斯AMG联合开发的V8引擎的两个版本。

它的推出标志着阿斯顿马丁开始在自己的车型 试验F1技术的应用。

与DB11同时发布的这款Valkyrie是一辆与 红牛车队联合打造的终极跑车。

它采用了全碳车身，拥有超过 的动力， 却是一辆可以合法上路的比赛级车型！

在走过110年的伟大历程之后，阿斯顿马丁还将继续 创造出更多令所有车迷趋之如骛的豪华跑车。
