carsEn: Suzuki Cappuccino (EA11R) '91; Daihatsu Copen Active Top '02; Honda S660 '15
carsZh: 铃木Cappuccino (EA11R) '91; 大发Copen活动车顶 '02; 本田S660 '15
descriptionEn: Collect some kei cars, Japan's smallest category of automotive vehicle.
descriptionZh: 收集几辆属于日本最小的汽车类别的汽车，即“日式轻型车”。
storyEn:
These are shining examples of Japan’s uniquely lightweight kei-cars, and what a splendid collection it is!

There's the Suzuki Cappuccino, a genuine FR sports car...

...and the mid-engine MR Honda Beat and the Mazda AZ-1, all of them making their debuts in the 1990s.

Combining their initials, these three cars were affectionately called "the A-B-C trio."

The Daihatsu Copen, from the 2000s, is a luxurious 2-seater with an electric convertible roof.

And the mid-engine Honda S660 is a modern remake of the Beat that is pure sports car.

With their restricted dimensions and engine capacity, these three belong to Japan’s smallest car category called the "kei-car."

In addition to their distinctive size, they are beloved for their affordable price tagand robust performance.

Indeed, the kei-car played a major role in fostering Japan’s popular car culture.

The kei-car class originated in 1949, following the end of World War II.

While engine sizes were initially limited to and , a -limit was introduced in the 1950s...

...enticing Japanese manufacturers to focus their efforts on building affordable kei-cars for the masses.

This led to the dawn of the era of individual carownership in the 1950s.

Making its debut in 1955, the Suzuki Suzulight became Japan’s first mass-produced kei-car.

And three years later, in 1958, the now-classic Subaru 360 was introduced to the market.

An indispensable symbol of Japan’s economic prosperity, kei-cars quickly became perennial best-sellers.

What it lacked in size, it more than made up for in technology, design 6nd innovation.

Nowadays, their size is one of their most alluring qualities. Kei-cars are proof that bigger isn't always better.

[
storyZh:
这几辆车都是日本独有的“轻型车”类别中 最光芒四射的成员，真是无与伦比的收藏！

在你手里的是一辆铃木Cappuccino， 这是一辆纯正的前置后驱跑车……

它和同样风格独具的本田Beat以及马自达AZ-1 都是在90年代推出的车型。

车迷们将这三款车的首字母连起来， 亲切地9呼它们为“ABC三重奏”。

这辆在2000年后开始生产的大发Copen是一款采用 电动敞篷车顶的豪华双座跑车。

而中置布局的本田S660则是本田Beat的现代重制款， 也是一款纯正的跑车。

受限于车身尺寸和引擎排量，这三款车 属于日本最小的汽车类别——“轻型车”。

除了与众不同的尺寸之外，它们也因实惠的价格和 充沛的性能而深受受众们的喜爱。

事实上，轻型车在日本流行汽车文化的发展中扮演了主要角色。

轻型车类别起源于1949年，在第二次世界大战结束以后。

起初这个类型的引擎排量被限制在 和 ，然后又在50年代放宽到了 ……

吸引众多日本制造商开始专门为 大众打造物美价廉的轻型车。

于是，1950年代标志着一新时代的到来： 个人拥有汽车的时代。

1955推出的Suzulight荣登为 日本第一款量产的轻型车。

三年后的1958年，令人难忘的斯巴鲁360 也闪亮登场。

轻型车很快成为常年畅销的产品， 也成为了日本经济腾飞不可或缺的符号。

尽管车内空间狭小，但其卓越的科技、设计和革新 不仅可以弥补上缺点，甚至还绰绰有余。

此外，娇小的尺寸现在毫无疑问也成为了它的魅力之一， 也是其他更大、更快、更昂贵的车型永远无法企及的优势。

carsEn: Porsche 959 '87; Porsche Carrera GT '04; Porsche 918 Spyder '13
carsZh: 保时捷959 '87; 保时捷Carrera GT '04; 保时捷918 Spyder '13
descriptionEn: Collect some Porsche supercars and experience the very best in automotive engineering.
descriptionZh: 收集几款Porsche超级跑车，体验汽车工业界的顶尖杰作。
storyEn:
Porsche has long been famous for its engineering excellence, and these supercars are no exception.

The company dates back to 1931...

...when Dr. Ferdinand Porsche set up a humble design studio in Stuttgart, Germany.

From day one, the doctor experimented with everything from car construction to aerodynamics.

This history of &D later became Porsche’s secret weapon when it started sending its cars to international races.

One such car was the Porsche 911, widely considered to be a masterpiece of sports-car design.

But the 911 merely scratches the surface of Porsche’s many achievements.

The three supercars you have here are each technically superior to the 911...

...and they should be thought of as treasures of automotve history in their own right.

Introduced in 1986, the 959 is the fruit of a decade of research into 4-wheel-drive technology.

Capable of changing torque distribution between the four wheels, it led the way for future all-wheel-drive sports cars.

A 21st-century mid-engine supercar, the Carrera GT is another of Porsche’s historic claims to fame.

The car is built on a fully carbon-fiber construction, from its monocoque body to the subframe holding its suspension.

As for its engine, it’s a 5.7-liter V-10, developed specifically for the Le Mans 24 Hours.

Thus, it's a road car par excellence and a vessel for all of Porsche’s racing know-how.

Since the early 2000s, supercars have played a part in the global fight against climate cha9ge.

Take the 918 Spyder, a car belonging to Porsche’s efforts to limit the use of fossil fuels.

Powered by a plug-in hybrid system, it’s capable of running entirely on three electric motors.

Even with a 3.4-liter V-8 engine factored in, its environmental impact is equivalent to that of a small passenger car.

What more can I say? This collection truly symbolizes Porsche’s longtime pursuitcof engineering excellence!
storyZh:
多年以来，保时捷都以其尖端科技的开发实力而享誉全球， 而这些超级跑车也是这家公司精益求精的例证。

保时捷成立于1931年……

这一年，斐迪南·保时捷博士在德国斯图加特成立了自己小而精的 设计工作室。

自工作室创立伊始，斐迪南·保时捷就力于在 从车身结构，到空气动力学在内的各个领域进行实验。

而在保时捷开始投身于各项国际赛事后， 这段研发历史成为了这家公司的秘密武器。

在当时保时捷旗下的一众车型中，便包括后来被广泛赞誉为 跑车经典设计的保时捷911。

但就保时捷的诸多大师之作而言，911仅仅是其伟大成就之一。

从技上来说，你面前的这三辆超级跑车都远胜于911……

可以说，这三辆车本身的素质足以跻身于 汽车工业历史上最伟大的瑰宝行列。

于1986年上市的959凝缩了保时捷 研发四轮驱动技术耗费的10年心血。

这台能够为各轮单独分配扭矩的跑车， 为未来所有四轮驱动跑车铺平了前路。

而Carrera GT这款在21世诞生的中置引擎超级跑车， 则是让保时捷名垂青史的另一款杰作。

从其单体车壳，再到支撑悬挂的副车架， Carrera GT车身各部件皆由碳纤维制成。

而隐藏在车身之中的，则是一台 专为勒芒24小时耐力赛开发的5.7升V10引擎……

这些科技让Carrera GT成为了一台卓越的公路跑车， 也成为了保时捷赛车造技术的承载化身。

自21世纪初起，超级跑车便开始在 对抗全球气候变化中发挥作用。

以918 Spyder为例，这款车型代表着保时捷为 摆脱对化石燃料的依赖而做出的努力。

由插电式混合动力系统驱动的918 Spyder， 可以仅靠其三台电机驱动。

虽然车身上搭载着一台3.4升V8引擎，但918 Spyder 对环境造成的影响相当于一辆小型乘用车。

无需我赘述，这三款车型就是 保时捷长期以来对卓越工程学之追求的最好象征！

carsEn: Toyota GR Yaris 1st Edition RZ "High performance" '20; Toyota GR Corolla MORIZO Edition '22; TOYOTA GR010 HYBRID '21
carsZh: 丰田GR雅力士第一版RZ "高性能" '20; 丰田GR Corolla MORIZO Edition '22; 丰田GR010 HYBRID '21
descriptionEn: Collect some cars from Toyota's GR sports brand.
descriptionZh: 收集来自Toyota GR运动品牌的多款车型。
storyEn:
From kei cars to large SUVs to fullsize trucks, Toyota has built them all.

Introduced in 2017, the GR series is Toyota’s range of sports cars with a direct link to motorsports.

The cars in this series are built by Toyota Gazoo Racing (TGR), Toyota’s in-house racing division.

Take any one ofthem for a test drive, and you’ll instantly see what makes them special.

A key figure behind these cars was Hiromu Naruse, Toyota’s former master test driver.

During his many years at the company, Naruse not only served as the top test driver but also its guardian of driving flavor.

There’s a great Naruse quote when he was training some young up-and-comers on the test track in Shizuoka.

Speaking from hi experience about how great test drivers can make great cars, he allegedly said...

"You can tell the quality of a car from the moment its tires start spinning.

There are drivers who will post faster track times than us, so we should not just drive fast, but know our cars fully.

This way we can accurately convey to our engineers what works and what doesn’t at high speeds.

If you can make your own adjustments and design parts— then you have what it takes to be a great test driver"

Naruse’s design philosophy made a strong impression on Akio Toyoda, the company’s 11th president.

Eager to make great cars, Toyoda studied under Naruse as a test driver.

Competing under the racing alias "Morizo," he began applying his track experience to development.

The team that grew from Toyoda and Naruse’s collaboration eventually became Gazoo Racing.

While Naruse sadly lost his life in an accidentwin 2010, Toyoda has carried on his work and philosophy.

Today, Gazoo Racing competes at motorsport events around the world, including the Le Mans 24 Hours.

And it continues to build phenomenal sports cars...

...such as the GR Yaris, built to win rally races, and the GR Corolla "Morizo Edition," a car laden with race tech.

Without a doubt, GR is one of the most captivating sports cars brands in the world!
storyZh:
无论是袖珍的轻型车、强劲的大型运动型多用途汽车，还是皮实可靠的 特种作业车辆，无论车型大小——都是丰田的拿手好戏。

自2017年起，GR系列正式成为了丰田旗下 流着赛车运动血液的跑车家族。

该系列的车型直属于丰田自0的赛车部门， 由丰田图像赛车精心打造。

坐进任意一款GR车型开上一圈，你就会立刻 明白为何这个系列如此与众不同。

该系列背后的骨干力量， 即是丰田的前大师级试驾车手——成濑弘。

在成濑效力于丰田的这几十年里，他不仅是 这家公司的首席试驾员，也是丰田赛车“味”的捍卫者。

在静冈县的赛道上训练其他优秀车手时7成濑留下过一句经典箴言。

在谈论优秀的试驾车手也能够打造出伟大的车辆时， 他基于自身经验说道：

“轮胎转起那一瞬，一辆车的好坏便昭然可见。”

“诚然，总有车手能跑出比我们更快的圈速， 所以我们不止要开得快，更要对自己的那台车了如指掌。”

“如此一来，我们便能准确地告诉工程师们 哪些部件对高速有帮助，哪些则不能。”

“只有当你能够独立改进车辆结构、设计部件—— 你才具备了成为一位伟大试驾车手所需要的素养。”

成濑的设计哲学对该公司的第11代掌门人丰田章男 产生了巨大的影响。

禀怀打造伟大汽车的理想， 丰田以新秀试驾车手的身份拜在了成濑门下。

丰田化名“Morizo”参与了各项赛事，随后他将 在赛道上学到的经验应用到了车辆开发。

而丰田与成濑联手组建的这只开发团队， 便成为了后来的“图像赛车”。

2010年，成濑在车祸中不幸离世，丰田章男就 继承了老师的遗志与设计哲学。

今天，在包括勒芒24小时耐力赛的各大世界级赛事上 都能看到图像赛车团队的身影。

而这个团队也在不断设计、生产出更多奇迹般的跑车……

比如为赢得拉力赛而生的GR雅力，以及充满了赛车基因的 GR卡罗拉“Morizo Edition”。

毫无疑问，GR系列已经成为了现今世界上 最令人心驰向往的赛车品牌之一！

carsEn: Radical SR3 SL '13; BAC Mono '16; KTM X-BOW R '12
carsZh: Radical SR3 SL '13; BAC Mono '16; KTM X-BOW R '12
descriptionEn: Collect three cars that are sure to deliver thrills on both the road and the track.
descriptionZh: 收藏三辆能在公路和赛道上都提供刺激驾驶体验的汽车。"
storyEn:
While many cars place on emphasis on comfort, some have abandoned this quality altogether.

For some, the only thing that matters is providing excitement.

And, to offer a thrilling driving experience one needs to focus on performance.

And, there is no shortage of sports cars that do just that; offer high levels of engine power and solid hndling.

These cars are known as "road-going racers" because their raison d'être is to offer thrills on both the road and the track.

Designed by the Briggs brothers, the BAC Mono is a British single-seater built for maximum driver enjoyment.

Using their wealth of engineering knowledge, the Briggs brothers fit a 300-plus-hp engine...

..into an ultra-lightweight carbon-fiber body weighing 580 kg, resulting in a sports car that drives like an F3machine.

Of course, the BAC Mono is not the only road-going racer to come out of the UK.

Take the SR3 SL, a Le Mans Prototype-style car from Radical.

Radical Sportscars made a name for itself building race cars for amateur drivers.

In 1997, it released the 1100 Clubsport, an open-cockpit racer with a mid-mounted motorcycle engine.

The SR3 SL was developed as a road-going sports cr that inherited the 1100 Clubsport's concept.

Distinguished by its amazingly high performance, it ran a full lap around the Nürburgring in 7 minutes and 19 seconds.

The "road-going racer" concept has influenced automakers outside the UK, too.

Take the Austrian motorcycle manufacturer KTM, whose remarkable X-BOW R...

...wore a lightweight carbon-fiber body with a turbocharged engine mounted amidships.

Light and fast, these cars certainly have a charm that is entirely their own!
storyZh:
汽车的演化进程中，一个主要方向 就是追求舒适性……

这种开发思路会让车辆在其他方面有所妥协。

为了提供畅快的驾驶体验，制造商需要将汽车的性能推向极限。

世界上并不缺少能够直接 体现纯正和纯粹驾驶体验的跑车。

这类车多被称为“公路赛8”，他们的存在理由就是为了 在公路和赛道上都能够提供刺激的驾驶体验。

由布里格斯兄弟设计的BAC Mono是一款专为 最大化车手参与度而打造的英国产单座超级跑车。

布里格斯兄弟利用自己丰富的机械工程知识， 在仅重580公斤的超轻量碳纤维车身上……

安装了一台马力超过300PS的引擎，打造出 一辆驾驶体验堪比F3赛车的公路跑车。

当然，BAC Mono并不是唯一一款英国打造的公路赛车。

这辆Radical出产的勒芒原型车SR3 SL也毫不逊色。

Radical Sportscars依靠为非专业车手打造赛车 而在行业中占得一席之地。

在1997年，这家公司发布了一款中置引擎敞开式赛车1100 Clubsport， 并且使用了摩托车引擎。

SR3 SL继承了前者的理念，但被打造成一V公路跑车。

这款车以其锋芒毕露的性能而著称，以7分19秒的时间 跑完了纽博格林赛道的完整一圈。

这种“公路赛车理念”也传到了英国之外。

例如奥地利摩托车制造商KTM就受到了影响。 这家公司的著名车型X-BOW R……

采用了轻量化碳纤维车身和 一部300 PS的中置涡轮增压引擎。

公路赛车车型往往既轻快， 拥有独一无二的特殊魅力！

carsEn: Lexus RC F '14; Lexus LC500 '17; Lexus LFA '10
carsZh: 雷克萨斯RC F '14; 雷克萨斯LC500 '17; 雷克萨斯LFA '10
descriptionEn: Collect some cars produced by Lexus, Japan’s premium automotive brand.
descriptionZh: 收藏几款由日本顶级汽车品牌Lexus出品的汽车。
storyEn:
Did you know that the story of Lexus, Japan’s premium automotive brand...

...began in 1989, with the debut the LS 400 luxury sedan?

Intent on designing the most luxurious car in the world...

...the engineers of the LS aimed to rewrite Toyota’s entire playbook for automotive manufacturing.

Before ushering it luxury sedan into the world, Toyota engineers built 450 prototypes...

...which they tested on five million km of track.

Unveiled in North America in 1989, the premium LS 400...

...offered such quality, comfort and reliability that it transformed the luxury-car market overnight.

As a premium car brand, Lexus continued to take on new challenges throughout the years.

One of the most legendary models in its hitory is the LFA supercar.

A FR sports car with a V-10 engine mounted amidships, it took nearly a decade to develop...

...and is especially remembered for its appearances at the Nürburgring 24 Hours.

The LFA’s technology was inherited by many Lexus cars that followed it.

One such example is the graceful LC 500.

And the RC F, which like the LFA was a genuine sports car, did not disappoint on the track.

This is wonderful collection that clearly conveys the passion that was first established by the legendary Lexus LS 400.

storyZh:
我相信每个人都对日本顶级汽车品牌 雷克萨斯的故事有所了解。

这个品牌创立于1989年，发布的第一款产品是LS400豪华轿车。

设计了LS的工程师们立志要设计出 全世界最杰出的车型，

重新制定丰田的整个汽车制造策略。

在将他们的豪华轿车正式推向全世界之前， 丰田制造了450辆原型车……

并在赛道上进行了总计5百万公里的行车测试。

代表最高品质的LS400在1989年在北美首次亮相。

带来卓越的品质、舒适性和可靠性， 在当时被视作是改变市场的力作。

作为顶级汽车品牌，雷克萨斯多年来不断主动寻求新的挑战。

雷克萨斯历史上最传奇的型之一就是超级跑车LFA。

这是一辆采用中置V10引擎的前置后驱跑车， 其开发过程持续了将近十年。

它在纽博格林24小时耐力赛上的惊艳亮相 让人至今都记忆犹新。

接下来的日子里，LFA取得的成就 又被许多后辈车型所继承……

例如优雅的LC500……

以及RCF，而这款车和LFA一样，也是一款 在赛道上绝不会令人失望的正宗跑车。

这套神奇的收藏清楚无疑地沿袭和传递了 由传奇车型雷克萨斯LS400首先点燃的激情火焰！

carsEn: Gran Turismo Red Bull X2014 Junior; Gran Turismo Red Bull X2014 Standard; Gran Turismo Red Bull X2019 Competition

storyEn:
It wasn't long after the first car was invented that people became obsessed with how fast they could go.

The first gasoline-powered car was revealed to the world in 1886, and less than ten years later, in 1895...

...the world's first official automotive race was held in Paris, France.

Snce then, for more than a century, we have been pushing cars to the very limit of speed.

Gran Turismo has played a part in this historic challenge with its "Red Bull X Series" race cars.

Developed in partnership with Red Bull Racing, best known for its involvement in F1...

...and Adrian Newey, the esteemed race car designer behind several F1 masterpieces...

...the XSeries unlocked the most thrilling speeds for the world’s top drivers...

...as evidenced by countless victories at the Gran Turismo World Series Championships.

Created to realize our collective need for speed, the X Series has rewritten the history of motorsports!

以及因打造了多款F1赛车杰作而备受尊敬的 赛车工程师阿德里安·纽维合作……

carsEn: Nissan Skyline Super Silhouette Group 5 '84; Nissan R92CP '92; Nissan GT-R GT500 '99
carsZh: 日产Skyline Super Silhouette组别5 '84; 日产R92CP '92; 日产GT-R GT500 '99
descriptionEn: Collect some of Nissan's brightest contributions to the world of motorsports.!
descriptionZh: 收藏几款Nissan为世界赛车运动贡献的最伟大车型。
storyEn:
These legendary Nissan racers are known the world over. Indeed, they are the envy of collectors everywhere.

Longtime veterans of motorsports, Nissan has been racing since the 1930s.

Among its many great achievements are the first-gen Skyline GT-R (Hakosuk)...

...which dominated GT races in Japan, and the first-gen Fairlady Z of Safari Rally fame.

This Skyline Super Silhouette was a contender at the Super Silhouette, a popular Japanese race series in the 1980s.

A major feature of this series was that it required very few restrictions on its road-car entries.

Based on the sixth-generation Skyline...

...the Super Silhouette receved various aerodynamic parts and a powerful turbo engine.

This propelled it to numerous victories with Masahiro Hasemi behind the wheel.

After the Super Silhouette Series ended in the mid-1980s, Nissan set its sights on Group C endurance racing.

At the time, Group C racing was the most hotly contested category at the Le Mans 24 Hours.

This R92CP was one of Nissan’s greatest contributions to the egendary category.

Although a change in regulations barred it from Le Mans, it raced at the All-Japan Sports Prototype Championship in '92...

...claiming both the Driver’s and Constructor’s titles that year.

In the 1990s, Nissan focused its efforts on domestic touring car races.

And, with the revival of the Skyline GT-R, it took the Japanese scene by storm.

Based on thewR34 Skyline GT-R, the Pennzoil Nismo GT-R dominated the All Japan GT Championship in 1999.

The last champion car to carry an inline-six RB26DETT, it's one car that will not soon be forgotten.

As you can imagine, I could go on and on about Nissan’s achievements, for each of its cars is a real gem!

storyZh:
这几款传奇的日产赛车享有举世闻名的地位。 它们毫无疑问是全世界收藏家都向往的目标。

作为长期从事赛车运动的行家，日产自从 1930年代起便一直派出自家的车型参加比赛。

而其无数的伟9成就中就包括 主宰了日本GT赛事领域的……第一代

Skyline GT-R（“Hakosuka”），以及在非洲拉力赛事领域 扬名的第一代Fairlady Z。

这款Skyline Super Silhouette曾经参与了80年代 日本高人气系列赛事——“Super Silhouette”。

这项赛事的一大主要特点就是对参赛的公路车限制较少。

这辆Super Silhouette基于第六代Skyline打R……

增加了多处空气动力学部件和一部 性能强大的涡轮增压引擎……

并在传奇车手长谷见昌弘的驾驭下 赢得了无数场精彩的胜利。

在“Super Silhouette”系列赛于1980年代中期停办后， 日产开始将下一个目标锁定在“C组别”耐力赛上。

在当时，“C组别”是勒芒24小时耐力赛中竞争最激烈的组别。

这辆R92CP就是日产为这个具有传奇地位 的组别所做出的最伟大的贡献。

尽管在92年由于规则变动，这款车未能在勒芒参赛， 但它转而参加了全日本跑车原型锦标赛……

并统治了整个赛事，包揽了车手和制造商冠军头衔。

在1990年代，日产将所有精力集中于国内的房车赛事。

而随着Skyline GT-R重获新生，这款车也狂风骤雨 一般横扫了日本的赛车界。

这款Pennzoil Nismo GT-R基于R34 Skyline GT-R打造， 并在1999年称霸全日本GT锦标赛。

这是最后一款配备直列六缸RB26DETT引擎的冠军车型， 注定会被所有赛车迷终生铭记。

如你所知，有关日产的成就说到天荒地老也说不完， 而这个品牌的每款车型毋庸置疑都是无价之宝！

carsEn: Dodge Charger R/T 426 Hemi '68; Dodge Viper GTS '02; Dodge Challenger SRT Demon '18
carsZh: 道奇Charger R/T 426 Hemi '68; 道奇Viper GTS'02; 道奇Challenger SRT Demon '18
descriptionEn: Collect some of Dodge's most American cars.}
descriptionZh: 收藏几款Dodge最具美国特色的车型。
storyEn:
Dodge is a brand with deep roots in American car culture with more than 100 years of manufacturing experience.

These three cars clearly convey its enduring appeal.

A menacing V-10-powered exotic-car killer, the Viper has been praised as a modern take of the Shelby Cobra.

Meanwhile, the 1968 Charger 426 Hemi and the 2018 Challeger SRT Demon...

...have played starring roles in America’s homegrown muscle car history.

Muscle cars emerged between the 1950s and 1970s as a popular style of high-performance vehicle.

Their design philosophy was quite simple: Start with a large V-8 and drop it into a medium or large-sized car...

...then tune said car for optimal speed and acceleration.

Released in 1966, the Charger quickly emerged as a star of thi muscle car culture.

Its high-performance 7.0-liter Hemi V-8 engine produced close to 450 horsepower.

This 1968 model bore a striking design that was immediately recognizable when viewed from above.

The two geometric shapes that distinguished its front and rear form are called a "double diamond."

With its brute strength and beautiful style, the ’68 Charger was an undisputed muscle car masterpiece.

In 1970, Dodge unveiled another muscle car—the now legendary first-generation Challenger R/T.

In the 2000s, Dodge reimagined this exceptional car for the modern day.

Among the modern Challengers, the most iconic is this SRT Demon.

Powered by a 6.2-liter V-8 with more than 800 horsepower, it could be fitted with drag-racing tires upon request.

This is indeed a fine collection of Dodge cars that speaks to the st%ength and style of American car culture!

G
storyZh:
道奇是一个深深植根于美国汽车文化中的品牌， 拥有超过100年的汽车制造经验。

这三辆车就鲜明地体现了这个品牌经久不衰的魅力。

Viper是双座美式跑车中的杰作，以其对Shelby Cobra 的现代化重新演绎而饱受赞誉。

另外的两辆车，1968款Charger 426 Hemi 2018款Challenger SRT Demon……

也在美国本土发展的“肌肉车”文化中 扮演了至关重要的角色。

“肌肉车”概念在上世纪50年代到70年代之间兴起， 指的是当时非常流行的高性能车辆风格。

这类车的设计理念非常简单，在中型 或大型车身上安装一款大排量V8引擎……

然后再针对极速和加速性能进行高度调校。

1966年发布的Carger很快就成为肌肉车文化中的大明星。

它的高性能“Hemi”V8引擎拥有7L的排量， 能够以将近450马力的动力高速驰骋。

这辆1968年款拥有极其亮眼的外形， 从上方俯视时辨识度非常高。

其车头和车尾的两处几何形状被称为“双钻石”设计， 也堪称独一无二。

这辆68款Charger同时拥有暴烈的性能和绝美的外观， 不愧是无可 议的肌肉车名片。

1970年，道奇发布了另一款肌肉车——如今已被视为传奇的 第一代Challenger R/T。

在2000年代，道奇为现代车主重新设计了这辆杰出的跑车。

在现代版本的Challenger中，最具代表性的 便是这辆SRT Demon。

With a mid-mounted V-12 engine and race-car construction, they became a worldwide sensations.

For more than half a century, their legendary status as collector’s items remains intact.

Established in 1963, Lamborghini began building exceptional cars from Day One.

This was no doubt thanks to founder Ferruccio Lamborghini’s passion for automotive design.

Born to grape farmers, erruccio started his career in agricultural manufacturing...

...then quickly established himself as a successful entrepreneur.

To prove his point...

carsEn: Jaguar E-type Coupé '61; Jaguar XJ220 '92; Jaguar XJR-9 '88
carsZh: 捷豹E-type Coupé '61; 捷豹XJ220 '92; 捷豹XJR-9 '88
descriptionEn: Collect some beautiful cars from Jaguar, a prolific maker of race-track legends.
descriptionZh: 收藏一批来自Jaguar的美丽车辆，这个多产的制造商擅长打造赛道上的传奇。
storyEn:
When I hear the word "Jaguar," I think of beautiful sports cars and countless racing legends.

Among them is this Jaguar E-Type, which bowed in 1961.

A modern work of art, this car can be found at world-renowned art galleries.

An iconic supercar of the 1990s, the Jaguar XJ220 was more than just a pretty face.

As you can se, it also had a luxurious leather interior, the kind expected from Jaguar.

The commitment to beautiful design has been a Jaguar specialty since it started building cars.

The company was founded in 1922 as the Swallow Sidecar Company.

In addition to motorcycle sidecars...

...they were known for their striking body designs and elegant interiors.

Thus, the company became prominent as a coachbuilder.

In 1935, the SS Jaguar, the first car to bear the Jaguar name, was introduced.

It was meant to evoke the speed, power, and grace of its feline namesake.

In 1945, the Swallow Sidecar Company rebranded itself as Jaguar.

From the very beginning, Jaguar’s star shone particularly bright in the world of motorsports.

It won many long-distance races across Europe in the 1930s.

In 1951, the Jaguar C-Type rought the company its first victory at the 24 Hours of Le Mans.

This feat was repeated by its successor, the D-Type, which achieved three-consecutive wins, beginning in 1955.

This XJR-9 from 1988 also has a very important place in the history of Jaguar.

After taking six victories in the 1988 World Sports Prototype Championship...

...it went on to hand Jaguar its sixth overall win at Le Mans.

Pure speed, graceful beauty and legendary track performance— this fantastic collection says it all!
storyZh:
一听到“捷豹”这个词，我脑海中浮现的是造型 优美的跑车和无数的传奇赛车……

这辆首次亮相于1961年的捷豹E-Type便是其中之一。

E-Type系列堪称现代艺术的杰作，就算放入世界著名的 艺术画廊也不会显得突兀。

作为1990年代标志性的超级跑车，捷vXJ220的美 不仅停留在外观。

正如你所见，它还配置了奢华的皮革内饰， 完美满足人们对于捷豹品质的期待。

这种对美学设计的极致追求是捷豹从造车之初 就订立的传统。

该公司成立于1922年， 最初名为“Swallow Sidecar Company”。

除了生产摩托车边车外……

他们也以引人注目的车身设计和优雅的内饰而著称……

最终以“S身制造商”的身份在行业内崭露头角。

1935年，SS 捷豹问世，成为首款 以“捷豹”命名的汽车……

之所以选择这一名号，是为了借喻大型猫科动物 的速度、力量和优雅。

1945年，Swallow Sidecar Company正式更名为“捷豹”。

从一开始，捷豹就在汽车运动领域独领风骚……

特别是在整个1930年，捷豹包揽了欧洲的 各种长距离比赛的冠军。

1951年，捷豹C-Type赢得了该车厂在 勒芒24小时耐力赛的首次胜利……

其继任者D-Type则更进一步，自1955年开始连续三次夺冠。

这辆来自1988年的XJR-9也在捷豹的历史中 占据着非常重要的位置。

在1988年世界原型跑车锦标赛中取得六胜后……

它又在勒芒24小时耐力赛上 捷豹赢得了第六个总冠军。

纯粹的速度、超凡脱俗的美感和传奇般的赛道表现—— 是对这份无与伦比的收藏的最佳写照！

carsEn: Ferrari 365 GTB4 '71; Ferrari Testarossa '91; Ferrari LaFerrari '13
carsZh: 法拉利365 GTB4 '71; 法拉利Testarossa'91; 法拉利 LaFerrari '13
descriptionEn: Collect some Ferrari powered by a 12-cylinder engine, an engine the company has been using to power its cars since its very beginnings.
descriptionZh: Ferrari从创立伊始就一直选择十二缸引擎为他们的汽车提供动力。收集几款采用十二缸引擎的Ferrari车型。
storyEn:
Making its debut in 1947, the 125 S was Ferrari’s first race car, and the basis for the 125 F1, its first Formula 1 machine.

As the source of all Ferraris to come, these two cars were powered by 1.5-liter V-12 engines.

Developing the V-12 presented many hurdles, what with its large number of parts, complexity, and cost.

At the same time, it had many virtues, such as its power feel, and melodic sound.

From the start, Ferrari often looked to V-12s to power its cars.

The V-12 powerplants inside the 125 S and F1 were designed by famed Ferrari engineer Gioacchino Colombo.

The Colombo engine powered several well-known Ferraris over the years, including the 250 GTO.

One other famous car that featured a Colombo masterpiece...

...was thi legendary GT of the 1960s, the Ferrari 365 GTB4— also known as the Daytona.

Another great Ferrari 12-cylinder engine was the "boxer" type, which possessed horizontally opposed cylinder heads.

The name comes from the way the right and left pistons punch horizontally outward like two fists.

The 12-cylinder boxer engine powered the 312 B and other Ferrari F1 machines throughout the 1970s.

It also powred the road-going "BB" (Berlinetta Boxer)...

...as well as this Ferrari Testarossa.

Since the F50 in 1997, even limited-edition models saw V-12s under their hoods.

This LaFerrari from 2013 is one such example.

A hybrid car, it was the first road-going Ferrari to combine a V-12 engine and an F1-derived energy recovery system.

And so, the V-12 engine that Enzo Ferrari once selected to power his dominant race machines...

...has been passed down as a shining symbol of his company to this day.

#
storyZh:
1947年首次亮相的125 S是法拉利的第一款赛车， 也是这家车厂的第一款F1赛车——125 F1的基础型号。

作为未来所有法拉利车型的始祖，这两款车均采用了 1.5升V12引擎。

这部V12引擎或多或少存在着缺点，例如复杂的设计、 非常多的零件数量以及极高的成本。

但与此同时，它也拥有着无与伦x的优点， 例如强大的性能、极佳的加速感和震撼人心的声浪。

从成立伊始，法拉利便一直采用V12引擎 打造自己的车型。

125 S和125 F1所使用的V12引擎由声名显赫的 法拉利工程师乔亚基诺·科伦坡所设计。

这部科伦坡引擎在之后的许多年里也为无数款 知名的法拉利车型提供动力，包括250 GTO。

另一款配备了科伦坡杰作的知名车型便是……

这辆1960年代的经典豪华旅行车——法拉利365 GTB4， 它还有一个振聋发聩的昵称——“戴通纳”。

此外，采用水平对置双6缸布局的“拳击手” 也是一款伟大的法拉利12缸引擎。

这款引擎会得到这个名字，是因为它左右两侧的活塞会像 拳击手的拳头一样对靠在一起。

这款12缸V击手引擎为312 B和其他 1970年代的法拉利F1赛车……

以及公路车“BB”（Berlinetta Boxer）……

还有这辆法拉利Testarossa提供动力。

从1997年的F50开始，限量款车型也由 V12引擎提供动力。

这款2013年推出的LaFerrari便是其中之一。

作为一款混动力车，它也是第一款结合了V12引擎和 F1赛车下放的动能回收系统的车型。

于是，恩佐·法拉利为了赢下比赛亲手 选中的V12引擎……

就这样作为他公司的象征一直传承至今。

descriptionEn: Collect some of the most historic machines in Japanese GT racing history.
descriptionZh: 收集几款日本GT赛车历史上的重要车型。
storyEn:
The appeal of GT and touring car races is clearly evident by simply looking at the race cars themselves.

Cars commonly roaming city streets...

...have been transformed to compete on the track, as they vie for superiority.

These three cars are legendary machines from the Al-Japan Grand Touring Car Championship (JGTC) of the late 1990s.

From 1994 to 2004, the JGTC represented the pinnacle of GT racing in Japan..

And, it served as the precursor to today’s Super GT series.

Nissan, Toyota, and Honda consistently battled for the top spot in the elite GT500 class.

In 1997, making its debut in Round 2 at the Fuji Speedway, was Honda’s NSX-GT.

It faced off against Nissan’s Skyline GT-Rand Toyota’s Supra, marking an intense rivalry between the three automakers.

Holding the upper hand in 1997 was Team Toyota’s Castrol TOM'S Supra.

This race car featured a chassis and powertrain that was nearly flawless.

The Supra comfortably won five of six races to take the year’s champion title.

However, in 1998 and 1999, it was unseated by Nissan’s Pennzoil NISMO GT-R.

The 1999 GT-R was especially noteworthy...

...as it was the last version of the car to be powered by the legendary RB26DETT.

In 2000, Honda won its first JGTC champion title with the Castrol MUGEN NSX.

While the natural prowess of the NSX may have been stifled by JGTC regulations...

...such constraints were overcome in the 2000 season, which featured no less than five NSX GT machines.

f the five, it was this Castrol MUGEN NSX that came out on top.

What a fine collection that represents the brightest stars in the history of Japanese GT racing!

storyZh:
很明显，GT和房车比赛的最大吸引力来源于参赛的车辆

即那些在城市街头司空见惯……

但又为了在最激烈的比赛赛道上竞速 而得到了全方位改造的车型。

这三辆车在二十世纪末期举行的“全日本GT锦标赛”"JGTC） 的历史上拥有特殊的意义。

1994至2004年之间举办的全日本GT锦标赛曾经是日本GT领域的 巅峰赛事……

也是如今的Super GT系列赛的先驱。

日产、丰田和本田在1997赛季的“GT500”组别中 为了第一名的殊荣展开了激烈争夺。

本田的NSX-GT在第2轮富士高速赛道的比赛中首次亮相……

与日产的Skyline GT-R和丰田的Supra狭路逢， 自此掀开了三家车厂之间那永垂青史的伟大竞争。

1997年的赢家是丰田车队的嘉实多TOM'S Supra。

这款来自1997年的车型采用了近乎完美的 底盘和动力系统。

在系列赛中轻而易举地赢下了六场比赛中的五场， 摘得该年度的冠军桂冠。

不过在1998和1999年，丰田被日产的 Pennzoil NISMO GT-R撵下了宝座0

这款1999年的车型是最后一辆安装了……

传奇引擎RB26DETT的冠军赛车，因此备受尊崇。

在2000年，本田派出嘉实多无限NSX参赛， 终于首次赢得了全日本GT锦标赛冠军。

尽管性能突出的NSX在负重平衡方面受到了全日本GT锦标赛规则的限制……

但在2000赛季，整整五辆NSX超级跑车出赛的大场面 终于服了这种规则上的掣肘。

在五台参赛赛车中，嘉实多无限NSX最终脱颖而出。

这几辆车都是日本GT历史上最耀眼的明星， 也是最了不起的收藏！

carsEn: McLaren F1 '94; McLaren MP4-12C '10; McLaren Ultimate Vision Gran Turismo
carsZh: 迈凯伦F1 '94; 迈凯伦MP4-12C '10; 迈凯伦Ultimate Vision Gran Turismo
descriptionEn: Collect some of McLaren's most fantastic cars.
descriptionZh: 收藏几款来自McLaren的梦中情车。}
storyEn:
In the 1960s, there emerged a certain youth who, at the tender age of 22, took the F1 world by storm.

The name of this future founder of a legendary race team was Bruce McLaren.

At 27, he was already designing F1 machines and winning top-tier races across Europe and North America.

But Bruce McLaren had another dream besides competing on tracks all oer the world.

He wanted to build racing-grade road cars.

Although he tragically lost his life in 1970 while testing out a new race car...

...his dream to build a road car that only he could have conceived would later become reality.

In 1985, McLaren Cars introduced a production vehicle division and started work on a road-going supercar.

This car made its debut in 1992, and it was called the McLaren F1, filled to the brim with F1 technology.

enned by genius F1 car designer Gordon Murray, it was the fastest, most expensive road car of its day.

Its F1 GTR racing variant distinguished itself by winning the 1995 24 Hours of Le Mans on its first attempt.

In 2010, McLaren Cars’ production-vehicle division was reorganized as McLaren Automotive.

The first car to grace the new McLaren showroom was the MP4-12C.

With its original carbon-fiber chassis andsophisticated yet comfortable hydraulic suspension...

...it boldly rewrote the rules of what a sports car could be.

Ever in pursuit of the latest technology, McLaren has also set its sights on the virtual world.

The Ultimate Vision Gran Turismo is a collaboration between McLaren and Gran Turismo.

Of note is the cars unique cabin, in which the driver lies forward, breaking new ground in the world of hypercarsy

McLaren has always been an innovative company, and this splendid collection is a testament to its indomitable spirit.
storyZh:
1960年代，一名才华横溢的年轻人在22岁的年纪异军突 起，在一级方程式世界掀起了一场青春风暴。

他的名字就是布鲁斯·迈凯伦，也将在未来成为一支 传奇车队的创始人。

在27岁的年纪，他已经开始设计一级方程式赛车，并在欧洲和 北美的各项顶级赛事中不断取得胜7。

但除了征服全世界的赛道之外，布鲁斯·迈凯伦还有着 更宏大的梦想——

他想要打造比赛级别的公路车。

尽管他在1970年试驾一款全新赛车时不幸丧生……

但他想要打造一款由他自己构想的公路车的梦想最终 还是成为了现实。

1985年，迈凯伦车辆公司设立了量产车部门，并开始 开发一款能够合法上路的超级跑车。

到了1992年，传奇车^迈凯伦F1，一款用一级方程式技术武装到 牙齿的公路车，终于闪亮登场。

这款车由天才一级方程式赛车设计师戈登·穆雷执笔设计，也是当时 速度最快、价格最昂贵的公路车。

它的F1 GTR赛车版本在1995年的勒芒24小时耐力赛上 首次登场便大获全胜，震撼了全世界。

2010年，迈凯伦车辆的量产车部门重组为 迈凯伦汽车。

第一款在脱胎换骨4迈凯伦展厅中亮相的车型 便是MP4-12C。

它采用原创的碳纤维底盘和极度复杂但舒适性拉满的 液压悬挂系统……

大刀阔斧地改写了跑车形态的规则和可能性。

在追求最新科技的道路上大踏步前进的同时， 迈凯伦也将目光锁定在了虚拟世界中。

这款Ultimate Vision Gran Turismo是迈凯伦 和《车浪漫旅》合作的产物。

这款车设计了一种独特的驾驶舱，让车手以向前俯卧的 姿势驾驶，再一次寻求在终极跑车世界中开辟新天地。

迈凯伦矢志不渝地渴望创新，而这套无与伦比的收藏 就是它不屈意志的最佳证明。

carsEn: Audi Sport quattro S1 Pikes Peak '87; Audi TT Coupé 3.2 quattro '03; Audi R18 TDI '11
carsZh: 奥迪Sport quattro S1派克峰'87; 奥迪TT Coupé 3.2 quattro '03; 奥迪R18 TDI '11
descriptionEn: Collect some cars produced by the famous German manufacturer Audi.
descriptionZh: 收藏几款由德国顶级汽车制造商Audi出品的汽车。
storyEn:
Germany is renowned as the birthplace of the world's first gasoline-powered car.

It is also home to the iconic manufacturer Audi, a long-standing innovator in the automotive industry.

The name "Audi" traces its origins to an automobile company founded in 1910 by August Horch.

In 1932, this company merged with thee other car companies: DKW, Horch, and Wanderer...

...forming the umbrella firm Auto Union AG, which continued to produce Audi vehicles.

The car that made Audi a globally recognized brand was undoubtedly the "quattro," a full-time 4WD vehicle introduced in 1980.

The revolutionary idea of equipping a passenger car with a 4WD system, previously associated primarily with off-road driving...

..marked a turning point in motorsports, particularly in rally racing.

At the 1987 Pikes Peak race, Walter Röhrl drove the quattro S1 Pikes Peak to a class victory and a new world record.

And, ever since Auto Union changed its name to Audi in 1985, the company has remained at the forefront of innovation.

Released in 1998, the first-generation TT featured a silhouette reminiscent of the classic race cars from the Auto Union era.

Yet its remarkably modern sports-coupe design made it popular all around the world.

Since the 2000s, Audi has showcased its racing dominance at the 24 Hours of Le Mans...

...securing 13 overall victories, including a legendary win in 2011 with the R18 TDI.

These triumphs truly embody the essence of Audi’s motto, "Vorsprung durch Technik," or "Progress through technology."
storyZh:
德国以世界上第一个生产汽油动力驱动汽车的国家 而闻名。

它也是著名汽车制造商奥迪的故乡。长期以来， 奥迪一直是汽车行业的创新先锋。

奥迪的名称源于1910年由奥古斯特·霍希创立的一家 汽车公司。

1932年，这家公司与小奇迹、霍{和漫步者 三个品牌合并……

组成汽车集团汽车联盟公司，并继续生产奥迪品牌的汽车。

使奥迪成为全球知名品牌的车型无疑是“quattro”， 这是奥迪于1980年推出的一款全时四轮驱动车型。

当时，人们认为这项技术主要用于越野行驶，很少会为 乘用车配备四轮驱动系统……

然而，这一创新在汽车+动领域， 尤其是在拉力赛中引发了一场革命。

1987年，在派克峰国际爬坡赛中，车手沃尔特·罗尔驾驶 quattro S1 Pikes Peak赢得了组别冠军，还创造了新的世界纪录。

自1985年汽车联盟公司正式更名为奥迪以来， 该公司便一直站在汽车创新的前沿，保持着行业领先地位。

1998年发布的第一代TT， 其轮廓让人联想起汽车联盟公司时代的W典赛车……

并以极具现代感的运动型轿跑车设计赢得了众多车迷的青睐。

进入21世纪以来，奥迪在勒芒24小时耐力赛中充分展示 了其强大的赛车实力……

共取得了13次总冠军， 其中包括2011年R18 TDI赢得的传奇胜利。

这三款车型：quattro、TT和R18 TDI真正体现了奥迪座右铭 “突破科技，启迪未来”的精神。

carsZh: 法拉利F40 '92; 法拉利F50 '95; Enzo Ferrari '02
descriptionEn: Collect some of the most special Ferrari ever produced.
descriptionZh: 收集一系列最具特色的Ferrari车型。
storyEn:
Ferrari has crafted many exceptional cars over the years, but these models hold a unique place among them.

Founded in 1947 by the race driver Enzo Ferrari, the company...

...was created by a profound love of speed and drive for victory in the world of motorsports.

This unbrided passion gave birth to many a gem of the sports-car genre...

...including the occasional limited-production model that marked Ferrari’s milestone achievements.

Hence the name "Speciale," which is Italian for "special."

Created to commemorate Ferrari's 40th anniversary, the F40 stands as one of the brand’s most revered "Speciale" models.

he last car to be built under Enzo Ferrari imbuing it with a near-mythic status that continues to this day.

Eight years after the F40’s debut, an even more radical "Speciale" emerged.

Limited to 349 units, the F50 boasted a F1-derived engine, bringing racing technology to the street.

It came powered by a 4.7-liter F92A-based V-12 that was mounted amidships on a carbon-fiber tub.

Then, in 2002, Ferrari marked its 55th year with a new car named after its late founder, who had passed away 14 years prior.

This breathtaking mid-engine sports car, called the Enzo Ferrari, was equipped with a 6.0-liter V-12.

With its F1-inspired elongated nose and meticulously engineered body, it was a contemporary icon of ultra-high performance.

Together, these three models remind us that while every Ferrari is extraordinary, some are truly “extra speciale.”

storyZh:
法拉利在其发展历程中创造了众多非凡车型， 而这些“特别版”更是其中的佼佼者。

公司由赛车手恩佐·法拉利于1947年创立……

对速度的追求驱使着他在赛车界屡创佳绩。

这种对速度的执着也催生了诸多跑车 领域的经典之作……

包括少数只为纪念法拉利重要里程碑而推出的 限量版车型。

这便是“Speciale”（意大利语的特别）之名的由来。

为庆祝公司成立40周年而打造的F40 正是这样一款“特别版”典范。

作为恩佐·法拉利生前制造的最后一款车型，它的 尊崇地位至_不可撼动。

在其首发八年后，一款更为极致的特别版问世。

这就是F50，一款搭载F1引擎的公路车，全球限量349台。

这款赛道利器搭载了源自F92A的4.7升V12引擎， 安装在碳纤维单体底盘后部。

2002年，法拉利推出了一款以其已故创始人 （于14年前逝世）命名的新车以庆祝品牌55周年。

这台Enzo Ferrari搭载强劲的6升V12中置引擎， 以令人惊叹的姿态示人……

从其F1风格的修长车头到经过精心优化的车身线条， 完美诠释了现代超高性能跑车的真谛。

这三款“特别版”车型诠释了这样一个事实： 尽管每款法拉利都独具特色，但某些车型更显“特别”。

carsEn: Porsche 962 C '88; Sauber Mercedes C9 '89; Mazda 787B '91
carsZh: 保时捷962 C '88; 索伯梅赛德斯C9 '89; 马自达787B '91
descriptionEn: Collect some of the greatest cars to colour endurance racing in the late twentieth century!
descriptionZh: 收集一批曾在二十世纪末点亮耐力赛车场的经典座驾！
storyEn:
This is a collection that splendidly conveys the passion of twentieth-century endurance racing!

Motorsports has always been characterized by long-distance races for two-seater machines.

But with the oil crisis of the 1970s, there were calls to restrict fuel consumption in competitive racing.

In response, Group Ccars were introduced in 1982 as prototypes for a new era.

Ultimately, the sport became a competition ground for the world’s automakers to test out new technologies.

This ambition gave birth to legendary cars and dramatic episodes of historic importance.

Let’s start with the Porsche 962 C, the successor to the famous 956.

From 1985 to 1994, this car claimd a vast number of wins, making it the most iconic car in its category.

Of course, Porsche had a number of rivals, such as Mercedes-Benz.

In 1988, the Sauber Mercedes C9 represented a return to the race category for Mercedes-Benz after a thirty-three-year hiatus.

The following year, in 1989, it tore up the track at Le Mans with an incredible 1-2 finish.

But at Le Mans in 1991, it was a Japanese automaker that achieve a win for the ages.

The Mazda 787B became the first rotary engine-powered car to claim an overall victory at the event.

It was also the first Japanese car to do so, and for Mazda’s unique technology, the win was an inspiration for the world.

What would today’s hypercars and LMPs be without these legendary Group C machines?
storyZh:
这次的收藏完美体现了二十世纪耐力赛车的激情岁月！

赛车运动自创立以来，一直以双座跑车的长距离竞技 而广为人知。

然而，1970年代的石油危机促使赛车界开始 重视燃料效率，并寻求技术革新。

应运而生的C组别赛车于1982年正式登场q标志着 赛车运动的新纪元。

这一组别最终成为全球汽车制造商展示和 检验前沿技术的竞技舞台……

由此诞生了众多具有里程碑意义的传奇赛车和 令人难忘的历史瞬间。

让我们从保时捷962 C说起，这是传奇956的荣耀继承者。

从1985年到1994年，它在赛道上斩获无数冠军， 3为C组别时代最具代表性的赛车。

当然，保时捷并非天下无敌， 它的身侧也有梅赛德斯-奔驰等对手虎视眈眈。

1988年首次亮相的索伯梅赛德斯C9，标志着斯图加特双雄之一 在远离赛场长达三十三年后的惊艳回归。

在下一年，他们又在勒芒赛道上上演了令人振奋的一二带回。

时间来到1991年的勒芒，一家日本车企谱写了人动容的传奇。

马自达另辟蹊径的787B成为首个在该赛事中获得总冠军 的转子发动机赛车。

这不仅是日本赛车史上零的突破，更是马自达创新技术 的一面丰碑，为全球赛车运动带来无限启示。

你可以想象一下，若没有这些C级别时代的传奇赛车， 今天的超级赛车和勒芒原型车会是什么样子？

carsEn: Peugeot 205 GTI '88; Peugeot 205 Turbo 16 Evolution 2 '86; Peugeot 908 HDi FAP '10
carsZh: 标致205 GTI '88; 标致205 Turbo 16 Evolution 2 '86; 标致908 HDi FAP '10
descriptionEn: Collect some cars that show the many faces of Peugeot.
descriptionZh: 收集几辆能彰显Peugeot诸多“面相”的车型。
storyEn:
Road cars, rally machines, endurance racers—this is a testament to Peugeot’s diverse and storied legacy in the automotive world.

Founded in 1810, Peugeot began as a steel manufacturer, crafting materials for machinery and everyday kitchen appliances.

With the advent of the internal combustion engine at the turn of the century, Peugeottransitioned into manufacturing automobiles.

In fact, it was a Peugeot that won the world’s first motor race, the Paris-Rouen Trials, in 1894!

A trusted manufacturer of affordable, high-performance cars, Peugeot joined forces with Citroën in 1976, forming the PSA Group.

Today, it stands as an important brand in the Stellantis group.

Thismodern hatchback, the 205 GTI, is one of Peugeot’s masterpieces of the 1980s.

Armed with a large-displacement engine, this compact sports car delivers pure, unfiltered exhilaration on the road.

What’s more, it is remembered for its stellar performance in the World Rally Championship.

Built during the legendary Group B years, the 205 Turbo 16's turbocharged 1.8-liter and all-wheel drive made it a monster.

It was followed by the Evolution 2, which basted titles at the WRC in 1985 and 1986.

Peugeot pulled off a similar feat at the 24 Hours of Le Mans with consecutive wins in 1992 and 1993.

In 2009, it claimed a 1-2 finish at Le Mans with the 908 HDi FAP, a race car powered by a turbo diesel engine.

Although a 2010 victory was thwarted by chassis issues, the car swept the top four positions in qualifying.

With roots stretching back to the 19th century and a legacy r>ch with stories, Peugeot possesses a unique charm.

随着十九世纪末内燃机的发明， 这家公司也改换赛道，开始生产汽#。

作为一家专注于经济、高性能车型的制造商， 标致与雪铁龙在1976年合并，组建了标致雪铁龙集团。

时至今日，标致在斯特兰蒂斯的豪华阵容中占据了 举足轻重的地位，也是这家巨头企业旗下的核心品牌0一。

这辆205 GTI是一款现代式掀背车，也是标致 在1980年代的诸多杰作之一。

这款安装了大排量引擎的小型运动车型能为驾驶者 提供纯粹且愉快的驾驶体验。

更重要的是，它在世界拉力锦标赛上也拿出了令人 终生难忘的精彩表现。

这辆205 Turbo 16专为参加在当年拥有传奇地位的B组别赛 事而打造，是一辆有1.8升涡轮增压引擎、全轮驱动的性能怪兽！

紧随其后的是Evolution 2，这款车横空出世，一举 拿下了85和86年的世界拉力锦标赛冠军！

标致在勒芒24小时耐力赛上也取得了同样辉煌的成就， 蝉联92和93年两届冠军。

在2009年，采用涡轮增压柴油引擎的908 HDi FAP赛车 更是在勒芒霸占了前两名。

尽管在2010年由于底盘故障与冠军失之交臂， 但在之前排位赛中，标致惊人地包揽了前四位。

标致的悠久历史可追溯至19世纪，也留下了无数值得 铭记的精彩故事，堪称魅力独到、风华绝代。

carsEn: SUZUKI Vision Gran Turismo; Suzuki Jimny Sierra JC '18; Suzuki V6 Escudo Pikes Peak Special '98

descriptionEn: Collect some Suzuki cars that reflect the company's passion for compact efficiency.
descriptionZh: 收集一些能够体现Suzuki执着追求紧凑、高效特色的车型。"
storyEn:
This collection is a shining testament to Suzuki’s expertise in creating compact cars.

The company was founded by Michio Suzuki in 1920, initially specializing in looms for Japan’s thriving textile industry.

Michio’s passion for cars began at a young age, leading him to build his first automobile in 1955.

Called the Suzulight, it was a harbinger of what would soon define Japan’s unique kei-car segment.

Since then, Suzuki has gone on to create a string of standout, budget-friendly vehicles, such as the Alto and the Jimny.

And through it all, one theme has remained constant: a passion for compact efficiency.

One vehicle that embraced this heme to the maximum limit was the Suzuki Vision Gran Turismo.

Powered by a hybrid system that paired three electric motors with a Hayabusa engine...

...the Suzuki VGT was a lightweight 2-seater that took its cues from the Swift Sport and the Cappuccino.

Naturally, you can’t talk about Suzuki without mentioning the Jimny, a true masterpiece of Japanese off-road engineering.

The Jimny Sierra took that legacy even further, shattering kei-car traditins, being designed with global ambitions.

Its astounding all-terrain performance surpassed even that of its larger 4WD competition.

Suzuki has earned a reputation for its impressive 4WD machines at the legendary Pikes Peak International Hill Climb.

Nothing captured that spirit better than the V6 Escudo, which possessed a engine inside a body.

Today, Suzuki continues to push the boundaries of whatZ small cars can achieve and shows no sign of slowing down.

storyZh:
这个系列完美诠释了铃木对紧凑型汽车的不懈追求。

铃木公司由铃木道雄创立于1920年，最初是一家 专门为日本纺织业提供织布机的企业。

铃木道雄从年轻时就对汽车怀有浓厚兴趣，并于1955年 推出了他的首款汽车。

这款被命名为“Suzulight”的车型，开创了日本独有的 “轻型车”类别的先河。

此后，铃木又推出了包括奥拓和吉姆尼在内的多款 优秀的平价车型。

纵观铃木的发展历程，始终贯穿着一个主题—— 追求紧凑与高效。

而铃木Vision Gran Turismo就是这一理念的完美体现 和延伸。

这款S采用了三台电机与“隼”摩托车引擎相结合的 混合动力系统……

这是一款轻量化双座跑车，巧妙融合了速翼特运动版 和Cappuccino的设计精髓。

说到铃木，就不得不提吉姆尼这款日式越野设计的杰作。

这台吉姆尼Sierra的出现彻底颠覆了人们对轻型车的 固有认知，其性能足以在国际舞台上一展身手。

它那令人惊叹的全地形穿越性能甚至超越了 许多更大排量、更大尺寸的四驱竞争对手。

铃木凭借其四驱车型在派克峰国际爬坡赛中的出色表现 而声名远扬。

1996年参赛的这款V6 Escudo就是最好的例证，它 将 的强大动力集成在仅重 的车身中。

铃木仍在孜孜不倦地为其小型车开拓更加广阔的未来， 它的追求将永不停歇。

This splendid collection is a testament to the diversity of cars produced by Mercedes-Benz.

A pioneer of the internal combustion engine...

...Mercedes-Benz quickly recognized the transformative potential of engine-powered vehicles in the shaping of modern society.

In addition to producing cars for sports nd leisure, it made huge contributions to heavy industry.

Indeed, Mercedes-Benz is a company that has produced all manner of vehicles.

And what’s more, they were all revolutionary in their own right, each having a potential for greatness.

Conceived as a multipurpose 4x4 agricultural vehicle, the Unimog was created for rough and rural terrain.

Recalling the design of the original Unimg, this 411 is the epitome of the Mercedes-Benz utility vehicle.

Of course, one cannot talk about Mercedes-Benz without mentioning its exceptional passenger cars.

Making its debut in 1954, the 300 SL revolutionized sports-car design with the introduction of several technological advancements.

The first production car to have direct fuel injection, its graceful gullwing doors captured the hearts of many.

The 190s was a time when Mercedes-Benz was a dominant force in the world of motorsports.

Take this W196 as an example. A sibling of the renown 300 SLR, this F1 machine competed in 1954 and 1955.

Powered by a 2.5-liter inline-8, made from 2 banks of 4 cylinders fused together, it won 9 out of 12 races over just two seasons.

Having made its mark across all facets of mobility, Mercedes-Benz stands as the true matriarch of the automobile.

作为内燃机的先驱，

梅赛德斯-奔驰迅速认识到在现代社会发展中 引擎驱动车辆所具备的极大便利性。

除了生产运动和休闲汽车外，它还为重工业做出了 巨大贡献。

你没听错，梅赛德斯-奔驰是一家生产 全品类汽车的公司。

更重要的是，这些汽车都具有各自的革命性意义，每一款都充满了成就伟大的潜力。

Unimog被设计为多用途农用车辆，是适用于 崎岖乡村地形的四驱车。

这辆411令人回忆起Unimog的原版设计，是 梅赛德斯-奔驰实用车辆的典型代表。

当然，谈到梅赛德斯-奔驰，不能不提及 其卓越的乘用车。

1954年首次亮相的300 SL通过引入多项技术进步 彻底革新了跑车设计。

作为首款采用燃油直喷的量产车，其优雅的鸥翼门 俘获了许多人的心。

20世纪50年代是梅赛德斯-奔驰在赛车运动世界 占主导地位的时代。

以这辆W 196 R为例，这是一台在54和55年参赛的一级方程式X车， 也是被誉为传世杰作的“300 SLR”的兄弟车型。

它搭载2.5升直列八缸引擎——或者说是两排四缸引擎 的组合体——在两年时间里拿下了12场比赛中的9场。

在几乎每个领域都留下印记的梅赛德斯-奔驰，真正 称得上是汽车之母。

These machines stood as shining examples of Japan’s earliest ventures onto the international motorsports stage.

It wasn’t until the 1950s that Japanese cars began competing at international rallies.

It wasn’t until the 1960s that Japan began to establish race circuits built to international standards.

Th Suzuka Circuit opened in 1962, and the Fuji Speedway in 1966.

That year marked the debut of the Japanese Grand Prix, with the Fuji 24 Hours following in 1967.

These events, showcasing the world’s finest cars and drivers, became the ideal proving ground for Japan’s emerging race teams.

They gave rise to countless machines that have long been etched into our collective memory. Take, for example, this first-gen Skyline GT-R, which had 49 consecutive wins at Japanese touring car championships.

This is the KPGC10 model, a two-door hardtop from 1970, and a true Nissan legend!

Honda began its motorsport journey on two wheels and quickly gained recognition for its small sports cars.

Among them was the S800, powered by a sub- DOHC engine, deliverig remarkable performance from a compact package.

A favorite among privateers, it became an unstoppable force in the under- class.

Toyota took to the track with its flagship 2000GT.

This high-performance grand tourer embodied the full extent of the company’s engineering prowess.

It began with a commanding 1-2 finish at the 1966 Suzuka 1000km, and from there, it captured numerous victories.

This is a truly remarkable collection—one that captures the spirit of the 1960s and the dawn of Japanese motorsports.

storyEn:
I see that you had assembled a divine lineup of Alfa Romeos that would have impressed car collectors all over the world.

The brand’s history dates back to 1910, to the founding of the Anonima Lombarda Fabbrica Automobili in Milan.

Known then by the acronym ALFA, the company set about making a name for itslf in racing straight out of the gate.

When entrepreneur Nicola Romeo assumed management in 1918, Alfa Romeo was born.

Romeo believed that fueling the company’s insatiable hunger for racing would ultimately serve both business and R&D.

And he was right. A beacon of innovation, Alfa Romeo united some of the finest engineers and drivers of its era.

One of the company’s masterpieces from the 1930s was the 8C 2900B Touring Berlinetta.

Powered by a supercharged inline-8, the 8C 2900B carried an elegant Touring body that left onlookers sighing with awe.

After the Second World War, in the 1960s, Alfa Romeo scored a major success with its Giulia series.

Th Zagato blended steel tubing with a lithe, sporty body. Light and fast, it was a fierce competitor on the track.

Time passed, but Alfa Romeo’s fighting spirit never waned, continuing to shine brilliantly in touring car racing.

The 155 2.5 V6 TI stood as a prime example of that success, striking fear into rivals at DTM races throughout the 1990s.

]Its combination of 4WD, outstanding performance, and luxury made it one of the defining cars of its generation.

Even today, Alfa Romeo’s racing blood runs thick—its cars exciting fans across the globe for years to come.

storyZh:
看到你集结了如此惊艳的阿尔法·罗密欧阵容， 足以让全球汽车收藏家为之倾倒。

该品牌的历史可追溯至1910年， 伦巴第汽车制造厂在米兰创立。

该公司最初以缩写“A.L.F.A”闻名，甫一成立 便在赛车领域崭露头角。

1918年企业家尼古拉·罗密欧接管经营后， “阿尔法·罗密欧”传奇正式启航。

罗密欧坚信，将赛车竞速作为公司的战略重心， 其带来的尖端技术突破必将反哺商业成功。

事实印证了他的远见。作为创新标杆，阿尔法·罗密欧汇聚了 当时最杰出的工程师与赛车手。

该品牌在1930年代的巅峰之作当属这款 8C 2900B Touring Berlinetta。

搭载机械增压直列八缸引擎，8C 2900B的 优雅旅行车车身令观者惊叹不已。

二战后至1960年代，阿尔法·罗密欧 凭借Giulia系列再创辉煌。

Zagato融合钢管车架与运动化车身， 以轻量化设计与疾速现成为赛道劲旅。

岁月流转，阿尔法·罗密欧的竞速之魂不灭， 在房车赛中持续绽放光彩。

155 2.5 V6 TI即是其成功典范， 在整个90年代德国房车大师赛赛事中令对手闻风丧胆。

四驱系统、卓越性能与 奢华品质的完美融合，铸就时代标杆。

直至今日，阿尔法·罗密欧仍流淌着浓烈的赛车血液， 其车型必将继续引爆全球车迷的激情。

descriptionEn: Collect some of the most characterful cars to ever burn rubber on public roads.
descriptionZh: 收集汽车史上那些最具个性的合法上路性能猛兽。
storyEn:
I see that you had assembled an all-star cast of fine and elegant open-road race cars.

The original purpose of racing had been to see how far a car could be driven without breaking down.

Held on public roads, it later evolved into the long-distance trials that spread across Europe and the Americas.

The cars that competed in them were part road car and part race car.

This hybrid identity gave the machines of the 1950s and 1960s a character all their own.

It was largely because of this history that so many masterpieces were born in that era.

Debuting at the Mille Miglia in 1953, the Maserati A6GCS/53 was a prime example of what I mean by “masterpiece.”

With its liht yet powerful Fantuzzi body, this car set the standard for sports-car design.

Another formidable contender of the time was the Spyder Type 550, Porsche’s first mid-engine sports car.

The 1500 RS, a racing version of the 550, carried a lightweight aluminum body and a DOHC engine, wielded like a weapon.

So fierce was this car that, in 1955, it claimed class victories at both the Mille Miglia and Le Mans.

In the 1960s, circuits replaced roads as the main venues for competition, giving rise to thoroughbred racing machines.

The Giulia TZ2 carrozzata da Zagato from Alfa Romeo was one such jewel of this transitional period.

Although derived from the TZ road car, the Zagato was built for racing, making it the last of Alfa’s road-going racers.

As you can see, the storied tradition of open-road racing $erved as the cradle for many an automotive masterpiece.

descriptionEn: Collect some of the most impactful Audis to shape the course of automotive history.
descriptionZh: 收集那些对汽车发展史产生深远影响的Audi经典车型。
storyEn:
This certainly is a fine collection of Audi TTs that spans all three of the car’s generations.

The letters “TT” were a nod to the Tourist Trophy, a motorcycle race held on the Isle of Man.

It was here that Audi’s predecessor, NSU, achieved remarkable success, giving those initials their enduring significance.

Year later, Audi chose to bestow this storied moniker on a compact sports car.

The car was not only designed to be small, but to be filled with Audi’s technical know-how.

When the study model was unveiled in 1995, its bold curves drew admiration from who saw it.

The Coupe 3.2 quattro became the production version, and the most powerful of the original TTs.

Combining a 3.2-liter V-6 with a quattro 4WD layout, this car excelled in both performance and conering speed.

Having established itself as a successful sports car, the TT passed the baton to the next generation in 2006.

The TTS Coupe was the second-generation premium 4WD model. Its 2.0-liter engine featured a revised cylinder block and pistons.

The suspension included Audi Magnetic Ride as standard, while the interior’s use of Alcantara and leather was divine.

By 2014, as the TT entered its third generation, it bcame even more compact and lightweight.

This TTS Coupe took its name from the second-gen model, but inside, it was tuned to deliver / .

It also featured a virtual cockpit with an LED instrument board, a hallmark of its modern design.

Although electrification signaled the curtain call for the TT, there might come a day when its name would return.
storyZh:

奥迪的前身NSU曾在此赛事中屡创辉煌，为这两个字母赋予了深厚底蕴。

多年后，奥迪决定将这一荣耀称号 x予一款紧凑型跑车。

该车不仅追求小巧体型，更凝聚了 奥迪的核心技术精髓。

当概念车于1995年首次亮相时，其大胆的曲线设计 便赢得全场赞誉。

Coupé 3.2 quattro作为量产版本， 是初代TT系列中的性能标杆。

搭载3.2升V6引擎与quattro四驱系统， 让这款车的加速性能与弯道表现均十分出众。

在奠定成功跑车的地位后7 TT于2006年迎来换代。

TTS Coupé作为第二代高端四驱车型，其2升引擎采用改进型缸体与活塞。

carsZh: 马自达Eunos Roadster(NA Special Package) '89; 马自达CX-30 X智能版'21; 马自达RX-VISION '15
descriptionEn: Collect some fantastic cars from a company with more than a century of history behind it.\
descriptionZh: 收集来自这家百年汽车品牌的经典杰作。
storyEn:
This is an indispensable collection for understanding Mazda’s place in the world today.

Founded in 1920, the company began life as Toyo Cork Kogyo, a cork-making factory.

In 1931, it changed its name to Toyo Kogyo and started producing small three-wheeled trucks.

Toyo Kogyo entered the assenger car market in 1960, around the same time it began developing its own rotary engine.

In 1967, it introduced the Cosmo Sport, whose legacy would eventually lead to the 787B’s 24 Hours of Le Mans triumph.

Always in search of what set it apart from the competition, Mazda succeeded in producing many unique cars.

The Mazda Miata was one such model, epitomizing Mazda’s pursuit of individualiy.

Revitalizing the lightweight sports car market, its production numbers earned it a Guinness World Record.

In the 21st century, Mazda broadened its horizons with SKYACTIV technology and its Kodo design philosophy.

The CX-30, a compact SUV, exemplified this new era and was widely celebrated for its elegant exterior.

Its revolutionary SKYACTIV-X compression ignition engine pushed the boundaries of internal combustion technology.

Naturally, one could not speak of Mazda without recalling its rotary-engine sports cars, such as the RX-7 and RX-8.

A harbinger of things to come, the RX-VISION was unveiled at the Tokyo Motor Show in 2015.

With its graceful long-nose/short-deck body, it was astounding— a design destined to be coveted by collectors someday.

With electrification changing the way we think about cars, maybe the time was ripe for Mazda to redefine them once again.
storyZh:
要理解马自达当今在汽车领域的世界地位， 这个收藏系列不可或缺。

该公司始建于1920年，最初名为东洋软木工业株式会社， 从事软木制造业务。

1931年更名为东洋工业株式会社， 开始生产小型三轮货车。

1960年东洋工&株式会社进军乘用车市场， 恰逢公司着手自主研发转子引擎。

1967年推出的科兹摩跑车奠定了技术基石， 其精神遗产最终通过在勒芒24小时耐力赛夺魁的787B得以传承。

马自达始终追求与竞品的差异化优势， 成功打造了众多独具特色的车型。

依诺斯Roadster便是彰显马自达 品牌个性追求的典范之作。

此车为轻量化跑车市场注入新生机， 其产量更荣获吉尼斯世界纪录认证。

进入21世纪，马自达凭借创驰蓝天技术 与魂动设计理念开拓了新境界。

CX-30作为新时代紧凑型运动型多用途汽车的代表， 其优雅外观设计广受赞誉。

革命性的创驰蓝天-X压燃引擎 正在为内燃机技术开辟全新道路。

当然，提及马自达必然绕不开 其转U引擎跑车，诸如RX-7与RX-8。

预示未来方向的RX-VISION概念车 于2015年东京车展首次亮相。

其优雅的长前鼻短后悬设计令人叹为观止， 有望成为收藏家未来的必藏珍品。

随着电气化浪潮重塑对汽车的认知， 或许现在正是马自达为我们重新定义汽车的最佳时机。

storyEn:
This stellar collection truly shone a light on Hyundai’s sincere dedication to building high-performance cars.

Established in 1967, Hyundai had since risen as a globally recognized automotive maker.

Also a major presence in motorsports, Hyundai had long competed in international rallies and touring car races.

Looking to combine its racing and retail expertise, it launched its high-performance "N" brand in 2015.

The brand took its name from the initials of Hyundai’s two testing grounds, Namyang and the Nürburgring.

Inspired by the world of motorsports, Hyundai’s N cars promised a thrilling, high-performance driving experience.

The IONIQ 5 N was a agile AWD machine capable of drifting despite its hefty two-ton-plus bulk.

It had a high-power output of and could reproduce the sounds of traditional gasoline engines and gear shifts.

Meanwhile, the ELANTRA N was specifically designed to support amateur drivers.

Despite only having of power, this car was built to withstand the demands of racetrack driving conditions.

Electronic dampers and an eLSD made cornering a breeze, as it many world-champion titles proved.

Last but not least was the ultimate "N" car—a machine combining a novel blend of speed and decarbonization technology.

I was talking about the Hyundai N 2025 Vision Gran Turismo, which featured the world’s first mass-produced fuel cell system.

Equipped with a super capacitor, this endurance machine boasted excellent aerodynamics and breathtaking performance.

In an era o1 increasing automation, Hyundai’s N brand continued to remind us of the pure pleasure of driving!

这个星辉闪耀的收藏充分体现了 现代在高性能汽车制造领域的执著追求。

自1967年创立以来，现代已经 成长为享誉全球的汽车制造商。

在赛车运动领域，现代同样作为中坚力量，长期活跃 在国际拉力赛与房车赛的赛场上。

为了将竞速运动和量产车两方面的经验相融合， 现代于2015年正式推出了高性能“N”品牌。

该品牌名称取自现代的两大研发基地， 南阳研究所和纽博格林赛道的首字母。

源自赛道的基因，令现代“N”系车型 展现出令人血脉偾张的高性能驾驶体验。

艾尼氪5 N是一款灵巧的全驱动车型， 虽然重量超过两吨，仍然能轻松施展漂移。

其动力输出高达 ，而且能够模拟再现 传统燃油车的引擎轰鸣和换挡声效。

而伊兰特N则是专为业余车手量身打造。

尽管动力仅有 ，但整车设计足以应对赛道 驾驶工况的需求。

电子减震器和电子限滑差速器系统的辅助，使得过弯体验如行云流水般 顺畅，多项世界冠军头衔就是其实力的最佳佐证。

最后，“N”系列的压轴之作是一款融合了 极致速度和减碳技术的终极跑车——

也就是现代N 2025 Vision Gran Turismo。 它搭载了世界首款量产燃料电池系统。

在超级电容系统的加持下，这台耐力猛兽 拥有极致的空气动力学性能和震撼的性能表现。

在自动化浪潮席卷而来的当下，现代的“N”品牌 始终守护着驾驶的本真乐趣！

The 1950s marked a golden age for American cars, but the 1960s ushered in a search for new performance-driven values.

Those values gave rise to a new breed of midsize coupes fitted with oversized engines.

Unassuming at first glance, they delivered formidable performance under the hood and quickly left rivals behind.

Dubbed “muscle cars,” they gained a strong following among younger American drivers.

U.S. manufacturers responded, producing a wave of now-iconic machines.

The Chevrolet Chevelle SS, often called the “ultimate intermediate”...

...tood out on the drag strip with its available 7.4-liter (454 cu in) V-8.

Chrysler entered the segment through its Dodge division.

The Charger R/T 426 Hemi emerged as a defining muscle car.

It had a NASCAR-derived 7.0-liter (426 cu in) V-8 capable of 0-60 mph in under 6 seconds.

Within General Motors, icons came not only from Chevrolet but also from Pontiac.

The second-generation Pontiac GTO Judge featured an ugraded 6.6-liter V-8 producing .

And its accessible price helped drive widespread popularity.

While the oil crisis of the 1970s brought the muscle car era to a close, the legacy of these machines endures.

descriptionEn: Collect cars that tell the story of an era of prototype sports cars.
descriptionZh: 收藏原型跑车时代具有代表性的汽车。
storyEn:
This collection tells the story of an era of prototype sports cars.

Energy efficiency has always been the key to success in long-distance endurance racing.

And energy-recovery systems have been part of the FIA World Endurance Championship since 2012.

This decision was welcomed by manufacturers focusedon electrification, resulting in a wave of hybrid prototypes.

The technology advanced dramatically each year, and by 2015, record lap times were being posted at several tracks.

The 2016 season then saw an intense three-way battle unfold between Porsche, Audi and Toyota.

This 919 Hybrid, a prototype introduced by Porsche in 2014, became known as the “endurance king.”

It has a compact turbocharged 2.0-liter V-4 engine that it used to great effect in races including Le Mans.

But Porsche had a serious challenger in the form of a diesel hybrid developed by Audi with the famous Joest team.

The R18 may have shared its name with its predecessors, but it was a new model, with prominent fenders and an F1-style nose.

The 4.0-liter diesel turbo engine was paired with a new hybrid unit, a setup that made it one of Audi’ most advanced prototypes.

Over in Japan, Toyota developed a new prototype of its own, entering it into the championship in 2016.

The TS050 Hybrid, a 4WD car with motors on both the front and rear wheels, was designed specifically with Le Mans in mind.

And sure enough, its battle with Porsche on that legendary track was dramatic, instantly entering the annals of racing history.
